title: Mohamed Salah signs two-year deal with Trabzonspor after Liverpool exit
english: Egyptian football star Mohamed Salah has joined the Turkish club Trabzonspor on a two-year contract following his departure from Liverpool. After nine successful years in the Premier League, the 34-year-old forward moved as a free agent to continue his career in Turkey. He arrived in Istanbul to a warm welcome from fans and is set to be officially presented by the club shortly.
amharic: የግብፁ እግር ኳስ ኮከብ መሀመድ ሳላህ ከሊቨርፑል ጋር ከተለያየ በኋላ በቱርኩ ትራብዞንስፖር ክለብ ውስጥ ለሁለት ዓመታት ለመጫወት ተስማምቷል። በፕሪሚየር ሊጉ ለዘጠኝ ዓመታት ውጤታማ ቆይታ የነበረው የ34 ዓመቱ አጥቂ፣ አዲሱን የውድድር ዘመን በቱርክ ለማሳለፍ በነጻ ዝውውር ተፈርሟል። ወደ ኢስታንቡል ሲደርስ ደጋፊዎች ደማቅ አቀባበል ያደረጉለት ሲሆን በቅርቡም በክለቡ ይፋዊ የፊርማ ሥነ-ሥርዓት ይደረግለታል።
oromo: Taphataan kubbaa miilaa biyya Masrii Mohaammad Saalaah erga Liivarpuulii gadhiisee booda, kilabii Turkii Trabzonspor waliin waliigaltee waggaa lamaa mallatteesseera. Piriimiyar Liigii keessatti waggaa sagal erga dabarseen booda, umriin isaa 34 kan ta'e Saalaah gara Turkii kan imale bilisaan ta'ee dha. Istanbul yommuu gahu degertoonni isaa simannaa hoo'aa gootaniifii, dhiheenyattis kilabichaan ifatti beekamtii argata jedhamee eegama.

title: DR Congo Ebola health workers protest unpaid wages as deaths surpass 1,800
english: Health workers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have launched a strike due to months of unpaid salaries, complicating efforts to contain an Ebola outbreak that has already claimed over 1,800 lives. The protests in Ituri province highlight the difficult conditions faced by responders in a region heavily impacted by ongoing armed conflict. As the virus continues to spread rapidly, international health officials are calling for urgent support to ensure these workers are compensated and protected.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ለወራት ደመወዝ ባለመከፈላቸው አድማ በመምታታቸው ከ1,800 በላይ ሰዎችን የገደለውን የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። በኢቱሪ ግዛት እየተካሄደ ያለው ተቃውሞ በአካባቢው ባለ ግጭቶች ምክንያት የጤና ባለሙያዎች ምን ያህል አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደሚሰሩ ያሳያል። ቫይረሱ በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ በመሆኑ፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የጤና ተቋማት ባለሙያዎቹ ተገቢውን ክፍያ እና ጥበቃ እንዲያገኙ ጥሪ እያቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Hojjettoonni fayyaa biyya Kongo keessatti ji'ootaaf mindaa isaanii waan hin argatiniif sochii isaanii dhaabaniiru; kunis dhibee Ebola lubbuu namoota 1,800 ol galaafate to'achuuf yaalii taasifamu rakkoo keessa galcheera. Hiriirri naannoo Iturii keessatti taasifamaa jiru, hojjettoonni kun naannoo waraanaanis miidhame keessatti haala ulfaataa keessa akka hojjetan agarsiisa. Vaayiresichi saffisaan babal'achaa waan jiruuf, qaamoleen fayyaa idil-addunyaa hojjettoonni kun mindaa isaanii akka argataniif mootummaan hatattamaan akka deebii kennu gaafachaa jiru.

title: The old pact between Israel’s government and military has broken down
english: The longstanding tradition of private cooperation between Israel's government and military has collapsed, leading to frequent and public disagreements. Recent clashes between officials like Defense Minister Israel Katz and military leadership demonstrate a deeper struggle over who controls war strategy and security policy. This shift marks a significant change from the country's history, where the army and political leadership typically maintained a unified public image during times of conflict.
amharic: በእስራኤል መንግስት እና በጦር ኃይሉ መካከል የነበረው የረጅም ጊዜ ሚስጥራዊ የትብብር ባህል በመፈራረሱ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሁለቱ አካላት መካከል በይፋ የሚታዩ አለመግባባቶች ተበራክተዋል። እንደ መከላከያ ሚኒስትሩ እስራኤል ካትዝ እና በወታደራዊ አመራሮች መካከል የሚታየው ቅራኔ፣ የጦርነት ስልት እና የደህንነት ፖሊሲን የመወሰን ስልጣን የማን ነው በሚለው ጉዳይ ላይ ያለውን ትልቅ ክፍተት ያሳያል። ይህ ሁኔታ በአገሪቱ ታሪክ ውስጥ የነበረውን የጦር ሰራዊት እና የፖለቲካ አመራር አንድነት የሚያበላሽ ትልቅ ለውጥ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mootummaa fi waraana Israa'el gidduutti walitti dhufeenyi dhoksaa fi walitti dhufeenyi gaariin dura ture caccabuun isaa, har'a wal dhabdee ifatti mul'atu fidaa jira. Wal dhabdeen Ministira Ittisaa Israa'el Kaatz fi hogganoota waraana gidduutti uumame, tarsiimoo waraanaa fi imaammata nageenyaa irratti eenyutu aangoo qaba kan jedhu irratti wal dhabdee guddaa agarsiisa. Haalli kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti dura turee fi mootummaa fi waraanni yeroo waraanaa walii galtee uummatatti agarsiisuu qaban sana jijjiiree jira.

title: Infantino, FIFA try to move beyond botched World Cup sell-off: What we know
english: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has maintained his position following a crisis meeting in Morocco, where the organization apologized for the controversial and failed attempt to sell off the World Cup's future commercial rights. While FIFA has pledged to review its internal processes to better include member federations, criticism remains regarding their top-down decision-making style. Moving forward, the governing body faces ongoing pressure from international leagues and associations to improve transparency and consultation ahead of the upcoming presidential election.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ በሞሮኮ በተካሄደ አስቸኳይ ስብሰባ ቦታቸውን ማስጠበቅ ችለዋል። ድርጅቱ የዓለም ዋንጫን የንግድ መብቶች ለመሸጥ የተሞከረውን ያልተሳካና አወዛጋቢ ሙከራ በመቀበል ይቅርታ ጠይቋል። ፊፋ አባል ሀገራትን የበለጠ የሚያሳትፍ አሰራር እንደሚዘረጋ ቃል ቢገባም፣ ውሳኔዎችን የማሳለፍ ሂደታቸው ላይ ያለው ትችት ግን ቀጥሏል። መጪውን የፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ተከትሎ፣ ድርጅቱ ግልጽነትን እና አሳታፊነትን እንዲያሻሽል ከፍተኛ ግፊት እየተደረገበት ነው።
oromo: Pirezedantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiinoo walga'ii hatattamaa Marookootti taasifame booda aangoo isaa itti fufuu danda'eera. FIFA mirga daldalaa Waancaa Addunyaa gurguruuf yaalii godhame kan hin milkoofneefi mormii guddaa kaase sanaaf dhiifama gaafateera. FIFA adeemsa isaa fooyyessuufi miseensota isaa caalaatti hirmaachisuuf waadaa seeneus, akkaataa murtee itti dabarsan irratti komiin jiraachuun isaa itti fufeera. Filannoo pirezedantummaa dhufuun dura, FIFA iftoominaafi hirmaannaa miseensotaa guddisuuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa jira.

title: What came into force with the EU’s AI Act this week – and what didn’t
english: The European Union has officially implemented the next phase of its AI Act, the world's first comprehensive set of rules governing artificial intelligence. This regulation mandates that AI systems, such as chatbots, clearly inform users when they are interacting with synthetic technology. Companies must also ensure that AI-generated media is properly labeled, while facing significant financial penalties for failing to maintain these transparency standards.
amharic: የአውሮፓ ህብረት አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስን የሚቆጣጠር የመጀመሪያውን አጠቃላይ ህግ ተግባራዊ ማድረግ ጀምሯል። አዲሱ መመሪያ እንደ ቻትቦቶች ያሉ ቴክኖሎጂዎች ከሰዎች ጋር ሲገናኙ ሰው ሰራሽ መሆናቸውን በግልጽ እንዲገልጹ ያስገድዳል። ኩባንያዎች በሰው ሰራሽ መንገድ የተፈጠሩ ይዘቶችን ምልክት ማድረግ ይጠበቅባቸዋል፤ አለበለዚያም ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ቅጣት ይጣልባቸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Awurooppaa seerawwan kalaqa sammuu (AI) to'atu kan addunyaa keessatti isa jalqabaa ta'e hojiirra oolchee jira. Seerri haaraan kun sagantaawwan 'chatbot' jedhaman fayyadamtoota waliin yoo dubbatan ofi isaanii beeksisuu akka qaban dirqama taasisa. Dabalataanis, miidiyaaleen AI'n hojjetaman ifatti adda baafamuu qabu; yoo kana ta'uu baate garuu kampaanonni adabbii maallaqa guddaa irraa ni eeggatu.

title: Rights groups denounce Israeli killing of Lebanese journalist as 'war crime'
english: Major human rights organizations have classified the April killing of journalist Amal Khalil in southern Lebanon by Israeli forces as a potential war crime. The incident occurred when a building sheltering Khalil and a colleague was struck after a nearby vehicle was targeted, with reports indicating that Israeli forces also hindered rescue operations. Both Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch are calling for a formal investigation into these actions, describing them as deliberate strikes against civilians.
amharic: ዋና ዋና የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ እስራኤል የፈጸመችውን የጋዜጠኛ አማል ካሊል ግድያ እንደ የጦር ወንጀል መቁጠራቸውን ገለጹ። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ጋዜጠኛዋ እና ባልደረባዋ መጠለያ ይዘው በነበረበት ህንጻ ላይ ሲሆን፣ እስራኤል የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችንም አግታ እንደነበር ተገልጿል። አምነስቲ ኢንተርናሽናል እና ሂዩማን ራይትስ ዋች ድርጊቱ በሲቪሎች ላይ የታለመ ጥቃት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ ጉዳዩ በገለልተኛ አካል እንዲጣራ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa gurguddoon, ajjeechaa gaazexeessituu Amal Khaliil kan ji'a Ebla darbe kibba Libaanoositti humnoota Israa'eliin raawwatame akka yakka waraanaatti moggaasaniiru. Miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe, gaazexeessitittiin fi gargaartuun ishee bakka dhokataa turanitti haleellaan erga irratti raawwatamee booda, humnootni Israa'el hojii fayyinsaa akka hin geggeeffamne gufuu ta'uun isaanii himameera. Dhaabbanni Amnestii Intarnaashinal fi Hiyuuman Raayits Waach gochi kun haleellaa namoota nagaa irratti xiyyeeffate waan ta'eef qorannoon addaa irratti akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru.

title: Court hears Palestine Action defendant suffered from emotional turmoil before Elbit raid
english: In a recent trial, defense lawyers for Julija Brigadirova argued that she was struggling with severe mental distress and a personal crisis during the time of an alleged 2024 protest raid on an Elbit Systems factory. Her legal team stated that the prosecution lacks concrete evidence, such as financial records or planning messages, to support their claim that she was a primary organizer of the event. The defense maintains that her lack of involvement in the preparations is due to her fragile personal circumstances rather than a secret role in the operation.
amharic: በአንድ የፍርድ ቤት ችሎት ላይ የጁሊያ ብሪጋዲሮቫ ጠበቆች፣ በ2024 በኤልቢት ሲስተምስ ፋብሪካ ላይ በተፈጸመው ተቃውሞ ወቅት ተከሳሿ ከባድ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ውስጥ እንደነበረች ተከራከሩ። የህግ ቡድኗ በባለሥልጣናት የቀረበው ክስ ተከሳሿ የተቃውሞው ዋና አስተባባሪ እንደነበረች የሚያሳይ ምንም አይነት የገንዘብ ዝውውር ወይም የዕቅድ መረጃ እንደሌለው ገልጸዋል። ጠበቆቹ በወቅቱ የነበራት የግል ችግር ለተቃውሞው ዝግጅት እንዳትሳተፍ እንዳደረጋት በማስረዳት፣ ክሱ መሠረተ ቢስ መሆኑን አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Mana murtiitti, abukaattoon Julija Brigadirova akka dubbatanitti, bara 2024 dhaabbata Elbit Systems irratti haleellaa raawwatame jedhame yeroo sanatti, isheen rakkoo fayyaa sammuu fi miiraa cimaa keessa akka turte ibsaniiru. Gareen abukaattoota ishee, himannaan isheen qindeessituu guddoo turte jedhu ragaa qabatamaa kan akka baasii maallaqaa ykn ergaalee karooraa waan hin qabneef fudhatama akka hin qabne dubbatu. Akka abukaattoonni jedhanitti, isheen qophii haleellichaa keessatti hirmaachuu kan hin dandeenye rakkoo dhuunfaa ishee cimaa keessa waan turteef malee, shira keessatti qooda waan qabduuf miti.

title: Kuwait orders Iranian school shut: education ministry source
english: Kuwaiti authorities have officially revoked the license of the country's only Iranian private school, leading to its permanent closure. While officials did not explicitly state the motive, the decision follows a period of heightened regional tensions. This move aligns with similar actions taken by other nations in the region against institutions perceived to have ties to the Iranian government.
amharic: የኩዌት መንግስት በአገሪቱ የሚገኘውን ብቸኛ የኢራን የግል ትምህርት ቤት ፈቃድ በመሰረዝ እንዲዘጋ አድርጓል። ምንም እንኳን የትምህርት ሚኒስቴር ለውሳኔው በግልፅ የጠቀሰው ምክንያት ባይኖርም፣ እርምጃው በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት ጋር የተያያዘ እንደሆነ ተገምቷል። ተመሳሳይ እርምጃዎች ከዚህ ቀደም በሌሎች የአካባቢው አገራትም ተወስደዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Kuweyt manneen barnoota Iiraan kan biyyattii keessatti argamu tokkichi akka cufamu murteesseera. Sababaa murtee kanaa ilaalchisee ibsi ifaa ta'e ba'uu baatus, tarkaanfiin kun waldhabdee naannichatti uumamee jiruun kan wal qabatu akka ta'e dubbatamaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyoota naannichaa biroo kanneen dhaabbilee mootummaa Iiraan waliin walitti dhufeenya qaban jedhanii amanan fudhatan wajjin kan wal fakkaatu dha.

title: UK: Dozens of MPs urge Shabana Mahmood not to block evacuation from Gaza
english: Over 85 British lawmakers have signed a letter urging Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood to stop blocking the evacuation of Palestinian families from Gaza. The MPs argue that the Home Office is preventing family reunions by stalling applications and failing to fulfill commitments regarding medical evacuations. They claim these bureaucratic obstacles are unfairly targeting Palestinians and are calling for the government to honor its promises to reunite separated families.
amharic: ከ85 በላይ የብሪታኒያ ፓርላማ አባላት የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሻባና ማህሙድ ከጋዛ የሚሰደዱ ቤተሰቦችን እንዳይከለክሉ የሚጠይቅ ደብዳቤ አስገብተዋል። የፓርላማ አባላቱ የሀገር ውስጥ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር የቤተሰብ መገናኛ ማመልከቻዎችን በማዘግየት እና የህክምና እርዳታ ቃል ኪዳኖችን ባለማክበር እንቅፋት እየፈጠረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። መንግስት በችግር ውስጥ ያሉ ቤተሰቦችን እንደገና ለመገናኘት የገባውን ቃል እንዲያከብር እና ቢሮክራሲያዊ ማነቆዎችን እንዲያቆም እየወተወቱ ነው።
oromo: Miseensonni mana maree biyyattii (UK) 85 ol ta'an, ministirri dhimma keessaa Shabana Mahmood maatiiwwan Gaazaarraa baqatan akka hin dhiibne gaafatan. Miseensonni kun, ministeerri dhimma keessaa maatii walitti fiduu irratti gufuu uumuun fi waadaa gargaarsa yaalaa galame raawwachuu dhabuun isaanii kan isaan yaaddessu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mootummaan maatiiwwan sababa waraanaatiin gargar bahan akka walitti fiduuf waadaa seene akka eeguu fi gufuu biirokrasii dhaabu qaba jechuun gaafataniiru.

title: 60 Palestinians detained, 16 wounded by Israeli forces in raid on Qalandiya and Kafr Aqab
english: Israeli forces conducted a two-day operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp and Kafr Aqab, resulting in the detention of 60 Palestinians, including women and children. During the raid, 16 people were injured, with some suffering from severe beatings and tear gas exposure. Soldiers also damaged local businesses and forced several families out of their homes.
amharic: የእስራኤል ኃይሎች በቃላንድያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ እና በካፍር አቃብ ለሁለት ቀናት ባደረጉት ወረራ 60 ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በዚሁ ወረራ 16 ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ በደረሰባቸው ድብደባ እና የእንባ ጋዝ መጋለጥ ምክንያት ለከባድ ህመም ተዳርገዋል። በተጨማሪም ወታደሮቹ የአካባቢውን ሱቆች በማፍረስ በርካታ ቤተሰቦችን ከቤታቸው አፈናቅለዋል።
oromo: Humnooni Israa'el qophii guyyaa lamaaf turee buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa fi magaalaa Kafr Aqab keessatti gaggeessaniin, dubartootaa fi daa'imman dabalatee namoota Falasxiin 60 ta'an to'annoo jala oolchaniiru. Duula kana keessatti namoonni 16 miidhamaniiru; isaan keessaa muraasni isaanii reebicha cimaa fi gubaa gaazii imimmaaniitiin miidhamaniiru. Dabalataanis, waraanni sun suuqotaa fi manneen jireenyaa hedduu diiguun maatiiwwan mana isaanii keessaa baasaniiru.

title: Ebola outbreak accelerates as healthcare workers strike over pay
english: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is worsening rapidly, with the World Health Organization head warning that infection rates are outpacing current containment measures. The situation is further complicated by healthcare workers who have gone on strike due to unpaid wages. These frontline responders are now questioning their ability to safely manage the crisis while working in such dangerous conditions without compensation.
amharic: በዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ ኮንጎ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ በፍጥነት እየተስፋፋ መሆኑን የዓለም ጤና ድርጅት አስታውቋል። የኢንፌክሽኑ መስፋፋት የጤና ባለሙያዎች ደመወዝ ባለመከፈላቸው ምክንያት በጀመሩት የሥራ ማቆም አድማ የተነሳ ወረርሽኙን ለመቆጣጠር አስቸጋሪ ሆኗል። በግንባር ቀደምትነት የሚሰሩ የጤና ባለሙያዎች ካሳ ሳይከፈላቸው በአደገኛ ሁኔታ ውስጥ መስራታቸውን መቀጠል እንደማይችሉ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa RD Koongoo keessatti saffisaan babal'achaa jiraachuu fi duulli ittisaa guddina dhukkubichaa hordofuu dadhabuu isaa hogganaan Dhaabbata Fayyaa Addunyaa ibsaniiru. Haalli kun ogeeyyonni fayyaa kaffaltii hin arganneef jechuun hojii dhaabuu isaaniitiin caalaatti hammaachaa jira. Ogeeyyonni sadarkaa duraa irratti argaman kunneen, kaffaltii malee akkasumas haala sodaachisaa keessa taa'anii hojii isaanii itti fufuu akka hin dandeenye himachaa jiru.

title: Who was Cesar Gastelum, Mexican TikToker shot dead mid-livestream?
english: Cesar Gastelum, a popular 24-year-old Mexican TikTok influencer, was fatally shot by gunmen on a motorbike during a live broadcast in Culiacan. The attack occurred in a city currently experiencing intense criminal violence, making him one of many social media figures targeted in the region recently. Authorities are now investigating the motive behind the killing, though no suspects have been arrested yet.
amharic: የ24 ዓመቱ ታዋቂ የቲክቶክ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ ሴሳር ጋስቴለም በሜክሲኮ ኩሊያካን ከተማ ቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ እያለ በሞተር ሳይክል በደረሱ ታጣቂዎች ተገድሏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ድርጊት የተፈፀመው በከተማዋ እየተባባሰ በመጣው ግጭት ውስጥ ሲሆን፣ በቅርብ ጊዜያት ብቻ በርካታ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተጠቃሚዎች በተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ ተገድለዋል። ባለሥልጣናቱ ግድያውን እየመረመሩ ቢሆንም እስካሁን የተያዘ ተጠርጣሪ የለም።
oromo: Cesar Gastelum, beeksisaan miidiyaa hawaasaa TikTok kan umriinsa waggaa 24 ta'e, magaalaa Meeksikoo Kuuliyaakaanitti yeroo birodkaastii isaa raawwachaa turetti namoota mooraa daandii irraan dhufaniin ajjeefame. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame magaalaatii fi naannawa ishee keessatti walitti bu'iinsiifi yakki hammattee jiru keessatti yoo ta'u, namoonni miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamtii qaban kaanillee yeroo dhiyootti kanneen miidhaan akkasii irra gahe keessaa tokko ta'eera. Aangeyyoonni mootummaa sababa ajjeechaa kanaa ilaalchisee qorannoo eegalaniiru, garuu hanga ammaa namni shakkame tokkollee hin qabamne.

title: What the CJP protests reveal about India’s next generation
english: Recent protests in India following a medical exam scandal reflect a growing movement led by Generation Z, who are demanding greater accountability and fairness. These demonstrations highlight a widespread fear among young Indians that hard work and academic merit are no longer enough to ensure success. This movement is part of a global trend where young people are challenging traditional political systems to protect their future opportunities.
amharic: በህንድ የህክምና ፈተና ቅሌትን ተከትሎ የተነሱት ተቃውሞዎች፣ ተጠያቂነትን እና ፍትህን የሚጠይቀው የአዲሱ ትውልድ ንቅናቄ አካል ናቸው። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች ህንድ ውስጥ ያሉ ወጣቶች በትምህርት እና በብቃት ላይ ያላቸው እምነት እየተሸረሸረ መሆኑን እና የወደፊት እድላቸው አደጋ ላይ እንደሆነ ያላቸውን ስጋት ያሳያሉ። ይህ ክስተት ወጣቶች በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ በፖለቲካዊ ስርዓቶች ላይ የሚያደርሱትን ተጽዕኖ በግልጽ ያሳያል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti qormaata fayyaa waliin walqabatee jeequumsi ka'e, dhaloota haaraa (Generation Z) gaaffii itti gaafatamummaa fi haqaa gaafataniin kan hogganamuudha. Hiriirri kun, dargaggoonni Indiyaa hojii cimaa fi ogummaan isaanii gara fuulduraatti milkaa'ina akka hin mirkaneessine sodaa qaban agarsiisa. Sochii kun, dargaggoonni addunyaa guutuu sirna siyaasaa fi carraa isaanii irratti jijjiirama barbaadaa akka jiran kan ibsuudha.

title: Cambridge professor Jason Arday quits amid plagiarism allegations
english: Jason Arday, the University of Cambridge's youngest Black professor, has resigned following a new investigation into his academic credentials and research. The sociologist faced intensifying scrutiny and allegations regarding plagiarism in his doctoral work, which he has consistently denied. Although Cambridge had previously supported him against such claims, the emergence of new information regarding his qualifications ultimately led to his departure.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ወጣት ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር የሆኑት ጄሰን አርዳይ፣ በአካዳሚክ ብቃታቸው እና በምርምር ሥራዎቻቸው ላይ አዲስ ምርመራ ከተጀመረ በኋላ ከሥራቸው ለቀዋል። ሶሺዮሎጂስቱ በፒኤችዲ ዲግሪ ሥራቸው ላይ ተነሥቶባቸው በነበረው የቅጂ ጥሰት ክስ ዙሪያ ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ነበሩ፣ ነገር ግን እሳቸው ክሱን አጥብቀው ይክዳሉ። ቀደም ሲል ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከጎናቸው ቢቆምም፣ ስለ ብቃታቸው አዲስ መረጃ መውጣቱን ተከትሎ አርዳይ በገዛ ፈቃዳቸው ከሥራ መልቀቃቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirofesara gurraacha umrii dargaggeessaa kan ta'an Yuunivarsitii Kaambirijii, jeeson Ardaayi, qulqullina barnoota isaanii fi qorannoo isaanii irratti qorannoon haaraan erga eegalamee booda hojii gadhiisaniiru. Soshoo-lojistichi hojii PhD isaanii irratti hatattamaa (plagiarism) dha jedhamee erga himatamee booda dhiibbaa cimaa keessa turan, garuu himaticha gonkumaa hin fudhatan. Yuunivarsitiin Kaambirijii kanaan dura deggarsa isaanii ibsus, ragaalee haaraa dhiyaatan hordofee Ardaayi ofii isaanii hojii irraa akka gadhiisan murteessaniiru.

title: Hormuz deal ‘close’: What’s the latest on each side’s positions?
english: Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz for commercial shipping after establishing specific transit routes. This critical waterway, which serves as a major global energy transit point, was closed following military tensions between Iran, the US, and Israel. While negotiations are progressing, the deal's success may depend on whether outside parties allow the process to proceed without further interference.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በስትሬት ኦፍ ሆርሙዝ የንግድ መርከብ መስመሮችን ለመክፈት የሚያስችል የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ ተቃርበዋል። ይህ ለአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ወሳኝ የሆነው የባህር መስመር በኢራን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል መካከል በተቀሰቀሰው ግጭት ምክንያት ተዘግቶ ነበር። የሁለቱ ሀገራት ድርድር በመሳለጥ ላይ ቢሆንም፣ የስምምነቱ ውጤት ሌሎች ወገኖች ጣልቃ ሳይገቡ በሂደቱ ላይ በሚኖራቸው አቋም ላይ የተመካ ይሆናል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaanni galaana 'Strait of Hormuz' irra deebi'anii banuuf waliigaltee xumuraa irra gahuuf jedhu. Daandiin galaana kun dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaaf baay'ee barbaachisaa kan ta'e yoo tahu, waraana Iraan, Ameerikaa fi Israa'el gidduutti ka'een erga cufamee ture. Haata'u malee, mariin biyyoota lamaanii kun milkaa'uuf kan inni hundaa'u qaamoleen alaa dhimma kana keessa seenuu dhiisuurratti dha.

title: Indian journalist Tarun Tejpal convicted in 2013 rape case
english: A prominent Indian journalist, Tarun Tejpal, has been found guilty of rape and sexual harassment by a court in Goa. This ruling reverses his previous 2021 acquittal regarding an incident involving a former colleague at a 2013 conference. Tejpal, who has denied the allegations throughout the decade-long trial, now faces a potential prison sentence of at least ten years.
amharic: ታዋቂው የህንድ ጋዜጠኛ ታሩን ተጅፓል በ2013 በባልደረባው ላይ አስገድዶ መድፈር እና ወሲባዊ ትንኮሳ በመፈጸሙ ጥፋተኛ ተብሎ ተፈረደበት። ይህ የጎዋ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ ተከሳሹ በ2021 ከነጻነት ውሳኔ በኋላ የተላለፈ ነው። እስካሁን ክሱን ሲክድ የቆየው ጋዜጠኛው፣ አሁን ቢያንስ ለዐስር ዓመታት በሚደርስ እስራት ሊቀጣ ይችላል።
oromo: Gaazexeessaan Hindii beekamaan Tarun Tejpal, bara 2013 hojjettuu isaa durii tokkorratti gudeeddii fi jeequmsa saalaa raawwateera jedhamee mana murtii Goawaan itti murteeffame. Murtii kanaan dura bara 2021 innis akka irraa bilisa ba'e ture kan jijjiire yoo ta'u, abbaan murtiichaa yakka kanarratti erga ragaa qoratee booda gocha isaa kana mirkaneesseera. Tejpal hanga ammaatti himannaa kana haalaa kan ture yoo ta'u, amma adaba hidhaa waggaa kudhan hin gadi ta'e isatti murtaa'uu danda'a.

title: Iranian footballers who defied Tehran become Australian citizens
english: Two Iranian female soccer players have officially received Australian citizenship after seeking refuge in the country. The athletes decided to stay in Australia following fears of backlash for defying the Iranian government during a tournament. They are now looking forward to continuing their professional football careers while embracing their new home.
amharic: ሁለት ኢራናዊያን ሴት እግር ኳስ ተጫዋቾች በአውስትራሊያ ጥገኝነት ከጠየቁ በኋላ የዜግነት መብት አግኝተዋል። ተጫዋቾቹ በአውስትራሊያ በተካሄደ ውድድር ወቅት የኢራንን መንግስት በመቃወማቸው ሊደርስባቸው ይችላል ብለው በመስጋት ወደ ሀገራቸው ሳይመለሱ ቀርተዋል። በአሁኑ ጊዜ በአውስትራሊያ መኖር የጀመሩት እነዚህ ስፖርተኞች፣ የስፖርት ህይወታቸውን በአዲሱ ሀገራቸው ለመቀጠል እቅድ አላቸው።
oromo: Taphattoonni kubbaa miillaa dubartoota Iraan lama ta'an, biyya Awustiraaliyaa keessatti baqattummaa erga gaafatanii booda seera qabeessa ta'uun lammii biyyattii ta'aniiru. Taphattoonni kun tapha biyya Awustiraaliyaatti godhamerratti mootummaa Iraan mormuudhaan miira sodaachisaa keessa seenanii waan turaniif, gara biyya isaaniitti deebi'uu irra achumatti hafuu filataniiru. Amma lammii Awustiraaliyaa erga ta'anii booda, hojii isanii kan tapha kubbaa miillaa biyyattii keessatti itti fufuuf qophii ta'aniiru.

title: Rihanna is 'in the studio', says partner A$AP Rocky
english: A$AP Rocky recently revealed that his partner, Rihanna, is currently working on new music in the recording studio. The singer has not released a full studio album since her 2016 record, Anti, as she has been focusing on her successful business ventures and family. While specific details remain limited, fans are hopeful that this update signals the end of her long musical hiatus.
amharic: አሴፕ ሮኪ የትዳር አጋሩ ሪሃና በአሁኑ ወቅት አዲስ ሙዚቃ ለመስራት ስቱዲዮ ውስጥ እንደምትገኝ ገልጿል። ዘፋኟ እ.ኤ.አ ከ2016 'አንቲ' አልበሟ በኋላ በንግድ ስራዎቿ እና በቤተሰቧ ላይ በማተኮሯ እስካሁን ሌላ ሙሉ አልበም አላወጣችም። ምንም እንኳን ዝርዝር መረጃዎች ባይኖሩም፣ ይህ አዲስ ዜና ረጅም ጊዜ ያስቆጠረው የሙዚቃ እረፍቷ ሊያበቃ እንደሚችል አድናቂዎቿን ተስፋ ሰጥቷል።
oromo: A$AP Rocky akka ibsetti, Rihanna haati manaasii fi sirbituun beekamtu tun amma istudiyootti muuziqaa haaraa hojjechaa jirti. Rihanna albamii guutuu kan baaste bara 2016 yeroo ta'u, ergasii garuu hojii daldalaa fi maatii ishee irratti xiyyeeffachaa turte. Odeeffannoon bal'aan yoo hin kennamin iyyuu, oduun kun dheerachuu dheerachuu ishee muuziqaa keessaa ba'uu ishee kan agarsiisu ta'uu waan abdataniif fansiin ishee gammachuu guddaa qabu.

title: Sheikh Hasina vows to return, but will Bangladesh accept fugitive ex-PM?
english: Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has announced her intention to return home from exile in India, despite facing a death sentence for her role in suppressing a 2024 uprising. While she claims a duty to face her supporters regardless of the legal consequences, her announcement has triggered protests and renewed diplomatic tension between Bangladesh and India. The Bangladeshi government remains firm in its desire to see her extradited to face justice for the violence that occurred under her long-standing rule.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በ2024 በተነሳው ህዝባዊ አመጽ ወቅት በፈጸሙት ድርጊት የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባቸው በህንድ በስደት ላይ ቢሆኑም ወደ አገራቸው ለመመለስ መወሰናቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ሀሲና የህግ መዘዙ ምንም ይሁን ምን ህዝባቸውን ለመቀላቀል ዝግጁ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ ይህ አቋማቸው በባንግላዲሽ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ቀስቅሷል። የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ሀሲናን አሳልፎ እንዲሰጣቸው ህንድን መጠየቁን ቢቀጥልም፣ ጉዳዩ በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት ውጥረት ውስጥ እንዲገባ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Bangladeshi duraanii Sheikh Hasina, bara 2024 jeequmsa biyyattii keessatti gaggeeffame mormuudhaan himatamanii du'a itti murteeffamus, biyyattiitti deebi'uuf murteessaniiru. Hasina rakkoolee seeraa fi hidhaan isaan mudachuu danda'u irra darbee, deggertoota isaanii wajjin wal arguuf akka fedhan ibsaniiru. Ta'us, ibsi isaanii kun Bangladeshi keessatti mormii guddaa kaasee jira; mootummaan Bangladeshi ammoo isaan harka kennisiisuuf Indiyaa gaafachuu isaa itti fufeera.

title: What to know about this week’s US primary elections in Tennessee and Hawaii
english: Voters in Tennessee and Hawaii are casting ballots in primary elections to select candidates for the upcoming November midterms. Tennessee Republicans are aiming for a total congressional sweep following a redistricting process that split the state's only Democratic-leaning district. Meanwhile, Hawaii voters are choosing nominees for both gubernatorial and congressional seats as current officeholders face competitive challenges.
amharic: የቴነሲ እና የሃዋይ መራጮች ለህዳር ወር አጋማሽ ምርጫ የሚወዳደሩትን ዕጩዎች ለመምረጥ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫቸውን እያካሄዱ ነው። በቴነሲ፣ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ አባላት የክልሉን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ መቀመጫ የነበረውን የምርጫ ክልል በመከፋፈላቸው ምክንያት በሁሉም የኮንግረስ መቀመጫዎች አሸናፊ ለመሆን እየሰሩ ነው። በሌላ በኩል በሃዋይ የሚገኙ መራጮች ለክልሉ አስተዳደር እና ለኮንግረስ ውድድር የሚቀርቡ ዕጩዎችን በመለየት ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filattoonni Tennessee fi Hawaii filannoo sadarkaa duraa kan gaggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, kaayyoon isaas filannoo gaafa Sadaasaa irratti kan dorgoman filachuu dha. Tennessee keessatti, Paartiin Rippabilikaanii kutaalee filannoo durii diimokiraatonni itti injifatan jedhaman erga jijjiiranii booda, bakka buutota sagalee guutuu argachuuf carraaqaa jiru. Gama biraatiin, Hawaii keessatti filattoonni hogganoota mootummaa fi bakka buutota kutaalee filannoo isaanii filachuuf qophaa'aa jiru.

title: UK police confirm Uganda boxers unaccounted for after Commonwealth Games
english: British authorities are currently looking into the status of several Ugandan boxers who failed to return home following the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Scotland. While officials have received reports of missing athletes, the head of the Ugandan Boxing Federation clarified that some team members still have valid visas and may simply be visiting family. In addition to the four missing Ugandan athletes, reports indicate that at least one boxer from Pakistan also did not return as scheduled.
amharic: በስኮትላንድ በተካሄደው የ2026 የኮመንዌልዝ ጨዋታዎች ላይ የተሳተፉ በርካታ የዩጋንዳ ቦክሰኞች ወደ ሀገራቸው ሳይመለሱ በመቅረታቸው የብሪታንያ ፖሊስ ምርመራ እያደረገ ነው። የዩጋንዳ የቦክስ ፌዴሬሽን እንደገለጸው አትሌቶቹ የያዙት ቪዛ አሁንም የሚያገለግል በመሆኑ፣ ቤተሰቦቻቸውን ለመጎብኘት ቆይተው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል። ከዩጋንዳ አትሌቶች በተጨማሪ አንድ የፓኪስታን ቦክሰኛም በተቀጠረበት ጊዜ ወደ ሀገሩ እንዳልተመለሰ ተነግሯል።
oromo: Poolisiin biyya Ingiliizi tapha Commonwealth Games bara 2026 booda gara biyyaatti kan hin deebine miseensota garee boksii Ugaandaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira. Hogganaan federeeshinii boksii Ugaandaa akka jedhetti, atleetotni kunneen visa isaanii waan qabaniif fira isaanii gaafachuuf achuma turuu danda'u jedheera. Atleetota Ugaandaa afur irraa kan hafe, boksarri biyya Paakistaan tokkos yeroo isaa eeggatee gara biyyaatti akka hin deebine gabaasameera.

title: Shifting US politics offers opportunity for Palestinian self-determination
english: The recent victory of a progressive candidate in Michigan's Democratic Senate primary highlights a growing divide within the US political landscape regarding support for Israel. Public opinion polls indicate that American sentiment is shifting, with a majority of citizens—and even a significant portion of the Jewish community—now questioning unconditional aid to Israel. This changing climate provides a strategic opening for Palestinian advocates to push for policies that challenge the occupation and promote self-determination. While these trends do not guarantee immediate change, they signal that the traditional assumption of unwavering bipartisan US support for Israel is becoming increasingly unstable.
amharic: በሚቺጋን በተካሄደው የአሜሪካ ዲሞክራቲክ ሴኔት የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ ላይ አንድ ተራማጅ እጩ ማሸነፋቸው በእስራኤል ድጋፍ ዙሪያ በአሜሪካ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ያለውን ክፍፍል አሳይቷል። የህዝብ አስተያየት ጥናቶች እንደሚያሳዩት አብዛኛዎቹ አሜሪካውያን እና የአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ክፍል ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠው ያለ ቅድመ ሁኔታ ድጋፍ እንደገና እንዲታይ እየጠየቁ ነው። ይህ እየተለወጠ ያለው ሁኔታ ፍልስጤማውያን የራሳቸውን መብት ለማስከበር እና የኢስራኤልን ወረራ ለመቃወም የሚያስችል የፖለቲካ ግፊት ለመፍጠር ብርቅዬ እድል ሰጥቷቸዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ ለውጥ ፈጣን ውጤት ባያመጣም፣ በአሜሪካ ለረጅም ጊዜ የቆየው የሁለትዮሽ የድጋፍ ስምምነት እየተሸረሸረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Injifannoon kaadhimamaa garee jijjiirama barbaaduu filannoo gara fuulduraa irratti argame, siyaasa Ameerikaa keessatti dhimma Israa'el irratti qoodiinsi guddaan uumamuu isaa agarsiisa. Qorannoon yaada ummataa akka agarsiisutti, lammiileen Ameerikaa hedduun fi hawaasni Yihuudii illee gargaarsi Israa'elif godhamu haalaan akka qoramu gaafachaa jiru. title: Why is France developing a new nuclear strategy?
english: France is updating its national defense strategy to increase its production of nuclear weaponry. This initiative also involves diversifying the launch platforms available for its nuclear arsenal. These changes reflect an effort to strengthen the nation's military deterrence capabilities in a shifting global security landscape.
amharic: ፈረንሳይ የኒውክሌር የጦር መሳሪያ ምርቷን ለማሳደግ የመከላከያ ስትራቴጂዋን እያዘመነች ነው። ይህ እቅድ የኒውክሌር ጦር መሳሪያዎችን ማስወንጨፊያ መንገዶችን ማብዛትንም ያካትታል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች እየተለወጠ ባለው የአለም የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ውስጥ የአገሪቱን የመከላከያ አቅም ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Faransaayiin tarsiimoo ittisa biyyaalessaa ishee fooyyessuun meeshaalee niwukileraa oomishuu dabaluuf karoorfatteetti. title: In Odesa, no-one is safe from Russia's new Black Sea strikes
english: Russia has significantly increased its military attacks on Ukraine's Black Sea ports and civilian ships, creating a dangerous environment that is disrupting vital international trade. Recent strikes have caused loss of life among port workers and merchant sailors, making this region one of the most hazardous areas for global shipping. Despite the constant threat of drones and missiles, local employees struggle to maintain operations while dealing with the trauma of these ongoing strikes.
amharic: ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የጥቁር ባህር ወደቦች እና በሲቪል መርከቦች ላይ የምታደርሰውን ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምራለች፣ ይህም ለአለም አቀፍ ንግድ ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። የቅርብ ጊዜ ጥቃቶች በወደብ ሰራተኞች እና በመርከበኞች ላይ ሞትን በማድረስ አካባቢውን ለአለም አቀፍ የባህር ጉዞ እጅግ አደገኛ ከሆኑ ቦታዎች አንዱ እንዲሆን አድርጎታል። ምንም እንኳን የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶች ስጋት ቢኖርም፣ የአካባቢው ሰራተኞች በዚህ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ስራቸውን ለመቀጠል እየታገሉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Raashiyaan buufataalee galaana gurraacha Yukreenii fi dooniiwwan sivilii irratti haleellaa raawwattu daran dabaluun ishee, daldala idil-addunyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa geessisee jira. Haleellaan yeroo dhihoo kun hojjettoota buufata galaanaa fi humnoota doonii irratti du'a geessisuun, naannicha daandii galaanaa idil-addunyaa keessaa bakka sodaachisaa ta'e keessaa isa tokko taasisee jira. Haleellaan dooniiwwan (drones) fi misaa'elotaa yeroo hunda kan jiru ta'us, hojjettoonni naannichaa haala ulfaataa kana keessatti hojii isaanii itti fufuuf carraaqaa jiru.

title: Nigerian security forces rescue more than 300 abductees
english: Nigerian security forces successfully rescued over 300 individuals who had been kidnapped in separate attacks across Niger and Kwara states. This joint mission, involving the military, police, and intelligence units, is considered the largest single-day rescue operation in the nation's history. The victims, who were held in a national park, are currently receiving medical attention before returning to their families.
amharic: የናይጄሪያ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በኒጀር እና በኳራ ግዛቶች ተጠልፈው የነበሩ ከ300 በላይ ሰዎችን በጋራ ኦፕሬሽን ነፃ አውጥተዋል። በወታደራዊ፣ በፖሊስ እና በደህንነት አካላት የተቀናጀ ይህ ዘመቻ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ የተካሄደ ትልቁ የማዳን ስራ ተደርጎ ተወስዷል። በብሔራዊ ፓርክ ውስጥ ታግተው የነበሩት እነዚህ ተጎጂዎች ወደ ቤተሰቦቻቸው ከመመለሳቸው በፊት በአሁኑ ወቅት የህክምና ክትትል እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Naayijeeriyaa godinaalee Niijer fi Kwaara keessatti namoota butamanii turan 300 ol ta’an duula waloo gaggeessaniin bilisa baasaniiru. Duulli humna waraanaa, poolisii fi qaamolee odeeffannoo walitti fides kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti guyyaa tokkotti namoota baay’ee oolchuun kan beekamu dha. Namoonni bakka paarkii biyyaalessaa keessatti hidhamanii turan kunneen, gara maatii isaaniitti deebi’uun dura amma yaala fayyaa argachaa jiru.

title: Outrage as Ugandan football captain murdered in street gang attack
english: David Owori, the captain of Uganda's Sports Club Villa and a national team player, was tragically beaten to death by a group of robbers in Kampala. The 27-year-old was attacked near his home while trying to resist the theft of his personal belongings. His death has sparked national outrage and grief, leading to widespread calls for authorities to swiftly identify and prosecute those responsible for the crime.
amharic: የዩጋንዳው ስፖርት ክለብ ቪላ ካፒቴን እና የብሄራዊ ቡድን ተጫዋች የነበረው ዴቪድ ኦዎሪ በካምፓላ በዘራፊዎች ቡድን ተደብድቦ ህይወቱ አልፏል። የ27 አመቱ እግር ኳስ ተጫዋች በቤቱ አቅራቢያ በዘራፊዎች ተከቦ ንብረቱን ለመከላከል ሲሞክር በደረሰበት ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ሆስፒታል ህክምና ሲደረግለት ቆይቶ ህይወቱ አልፏል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በዩጋንዳ ህዝብ ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን የቀሰቀሰ ሲሆን፣ መንግስት ወንጀለኞቹን በአፋጣኝ ለፍርድ እንዲያቀርብ ጥሪ ቀርቧል።
oromo: Kapiteenni kilabii ispoortii biyya Yugaandaa ‘SC Villa’ fi taphataan garee biyyaalessaa Deevid Owori, magaalaa Kaampaalaa keessatti garee saamtotaatiin reebamee ajjeefameera. Taphataan umurii 27 kun manasaa biratti osoo jiruu saamtotaan erga weeraramee booda, miidhaa cimaa irra ga’een hospitaala erga geessamee booda lubbuun isaa darbeera. Ajjeechaan kun biyyattii keessatti aarii guddaa kan uume yoo ta’u, lammiileen mootummaan yakkitoota kana hatattamaan to’annoo jala oolchuu akka qabu gaafachaa jiru.

title: US military families face deportation after immigration protection ends
english: The families of American military personnel are currently at risk of being expelled from the country after the Trump administration cancelled previous immigration safeguards. Reports indicate that several spouses and parents of service members have already been detained or sent away. Experts suggest that the documented incidents are likely only the beginning of a larger trend affecting many military households.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር ሠራዊት አባላት ቤተሰቦች የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከዚህ ቀደም የነበሩ የስደተኞች ጥበቃዎችን በማቋረጡ ምክንያት ከሀገር የመባረር ስጋት ተጋርጦባቸዋል። እስካሁን ድረስ አንዳንድ የወታደሮች ባለቤቶችና ወላጆች መታሰራቸው ወይም መባረራቸው ተዘግቧል። የተደረጉ ምርመራዎች እንደሚያሳዩት እነዚህ አጋጣሚዎች በብዙ ወታደራዊ ቤተሰቦች ላይ ሊከሰት ከሚችለው ቀጣይ ችግር መጀመሪያ ብቻ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ይነገራል።
oromo: Miseensota waraana Ameerikaa waliin kan jiraatan maatiin isaanii, mootummaan Trump eegumsa seera godaantotaa dura ture haquu isaatiin kan ka'e biyyattii keessaa ari'amuuf saaxilamaniiru. Akka gabaasawwan mul'isanitti, haadhotiin manaa fi warri miseensota waraanaa tokko tokko ammaaf qabamanii ykn biyyaa ari'amaniiru. Qorannoon akka agarsiisutti, rakkoon kun jalqaba qofa ta'ee, maatiiwwan waraanaa hedduu irratti dhiibbaa geessisuu akka danda'u ibsameera.

title: Carney curses Infantino as FIFA backs its president
english: FIFA officials have reaffirmed their support for President Gianni Infantino during a recent emergency meeting in Morocco. This decision follows the collapse of his proposal to sell a portion of the World Cup. However, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney has publicly expressed that he no longer trusts Infantino's leadership following these events.
amharic: የፊፋ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች በሞሮኮ በተደረገ አስቸኳይ ስብሰባ ለፕሬዝዳንቱ ለጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በድጋሚ አረጋግጠዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡት እቅድ ሳይሳካ ከቀረ በኋላ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ በዚህ ጉዳይ ሳቢያ በኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ የነበራቸው እምነት እንደጠፋ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni FIFA walgahii ariifachiisaa Marookootti taa’een pirezidaantii isaanii Jaannii Infantiinootiif deeggarsa qaban mirkaneessaniiru. Murtuun kun kan dabarse qooda Waancaa Addunyaa gurguruuf karoorri pirezidaantichaatti milkaayuu dhabee boodadha. Haata’u malee, muummichi ministeeraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii dhimma kana hordofee Infantiinoorratti amantaa akka dhaban ifatti ibsaniiru.

title: Strait of Hormuz tolls would harm livelihoods worldwide, shipowners warn
english: Eight major global shipping organizations have written to the United Nations to protest potential plans by Iran and Oman to impose transit tolls in the Strait of Hormuz. The groups warn that these fees would violate international maritime laws and trigger significant global economic issues like inflation and higher energy costs. They emphasize that maintaining free navigation is essential for the world economy and should not be used as a tool for political bargaining.
amharic: ስምንት ዋና ዋና የዓለም የባህር ትራንስፖርት ድርጅቶች ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የጉምሩክ ክፍያ ለመጣል እያቀዱት ላለው እቅድ ተቃውሟቸውን ለተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት በደብዳቤ ገለጹ። እነዚህ ክፍያዎች ዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ህጎችን የሚጥሱ እና በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ የዋጋ ግሽበትን እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመርን የመሳሰሉ ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውሶችን እንደሚያስከትሉ አስጠንቅቀዋል። የባህር ላይ ነፃ እንቅስቃሴ የዓለም ኢኮኖሚ መሰረት በመሆኑ ለፖለቲካዊ ድርድሮች መጠቀም እንደሌለበት ድርጅቶቹ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Jaarmayoonni dooniiwwan gurguddoon saddeet, biyyoonni Iraan fi Omaaniin daandii bishaan Hormuz irratti gibira kaffaltii godhuuf karoorfataniin mormuuf gara dhaabbata mootummoota gamtoomaniitti barreeffama erganiiru. Kaffaltiin kun seera qaxxaamura galaanaa idil-addunyaa kan cabsu fi gatii boba'aa dabaluun dinagdee addunyaa irratti miidhaa guddaa akka geessisu akeekkachiisaniiru. Waldaaleen kun bilisummaan dooniiwwan darbuu bu'uura dinagdee addunyaa waan ta'eef, dhimmoota siyaasaa keessatti meeshaa daldalaa ta'uu akka hin qabne ibsaniiru.

title: Trump attacks El-Sayed as ‘hater of Jews’ after Michigan win
english: Former President Donald Trump has publicly criticized Michigan Democratic candidate Abdul El-Sayed, labeling him as someone who harbors hatred toward Jewish people and Israel. This verbal attack occurred following El-Sayed's recent primary victory, where he succeeded despite facing significant financial opposition from pro-Israel lobby groups. Trump’s comments reflect the ongoing political tension surrounding the candidate's campaign.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ እጩ በሆኑት አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ ላይ አይሁዶችን እና እስራኤልን የሚጠሉ ሰው ናቸው የሚል ክስ ሰንዝረዋል። ይህ ትችት የተሰነዘረው ኤል-ሰይድ እስራኤልን በሚደግፉ ቡድኖች የተሰጠውን ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ተጽዕኖ በመቋቋም በምርጫ ማሸነፋቸውን ተከትሎ ነው። የትራምፕ አስተያየት በዕጩው የምርጫ ቅስቀሳ ዙሪያ ያለውን ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Donald Tiraamp, kaadhimamaa Paartii Dimookiraatawaa kan Michigaan kan ta'an Abdul El-Sayed irratti, jibbiinsa Yihuudootaa fi Israa'el qabu jechuun komataniiru. Komiin kun kan dhufe erga El-Sayed gareewwan Israa'el deggeran irraa dhiibbaa maallaqaa cimaa mudatee booda injifannoo argateen booda dha. Yaadni Tiraamp kun marii siyaasaa kaadhimamaa kanaa irratti jiru kan calaqqisu dha.

title: Israeli violence escalating in the West Bank, several left wounded in settler arson attacks
english: Violence has intensified in the West Bank as Israeli settlers conducted arson attacks and seized water resources from Palestinian communities. Multiple residents were wounded during these incidents and during separate military raids across several towns and refugee camps. These actions have resulted in widespread property damage and physical injuries to numerous civilians, including women and children.
amharic: በምዕራብ ባንክ የእስራኤል ሰፋሪዎች ባደረሱት የእሳት ቃጠሎ እና የውሃ ሀብት መዝረፍ ግጭቱ ተባብሷል። በእነዚህ ጥቃቶች እና በተለያዩ ከተሞችና የስደተኞች መጠለያ ጣቢያዎች በተፈጸሙ ወታደራዊ ወረራዎች በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በበርካታ ንፁሃን ዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት ከማድረሱም በላይ የንብረት ውድመት አስከትሏል።
oromo: Naannoo Baankii Dhihaaitti haleellaan qaqqabu daran dabalaa dhufeera; kunis qe'ee warra Falasxiin irratti gubaa fi saamicha bishaanii kan dabalatudha. Haleellaa kanaa fi duula waraanaa iddoo garaagaraatti gaggeeffameen namoonni hedduun miidhamaniiru. Gochi kun namoota nagaa hedduu irratti miidhaa qaamaa fi mancaatii qabeenyaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: Israeli army escalates strikes in south Lebanon, at least four wounded
english: The Israeli military has intensified its aerial attacks across southern Lebanon, specifically targeting multiple locations in the city of Tyre. These strikes resulted in four injuries and forced many local residents to flee their homes for safety. The operation is being described as a significant escalation in the ongoing regional conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የጢሮስ ከተማ ላይ ያደረሰውን የአየር ጥቃት በከፍተኛ ደረጃ አጠናክሯል። በዚህ ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ጉዳት የደረሰባቸው ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ነዋሪዎችም ከመኖሪያ ቀያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት አባባሽ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessatti magaalota garaa garaa irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwatu hamma tokko dabaluun isaa gabaafameera. Haleellaa magaalaa Xayroos keessatti raawwatame kanaan namoonni afur madaa'anii gara hospitaalaatti ergamaniiru, akkasumas jiraattonni hedduun naannicha gadhiisanii baqachuuf dirqamaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan hammaata deemu ta'uu ibsameera.

title: Trump slams reports on munition shortages, says US army has 'massive amounts' of weapons
english: Donald Trump has dismissed media claims regarding a shortage of U.S. munitions, asserting that the country possesses substantial stockpiles and is actively increasing production. He highlighted that domestic defense companies are currently building numerous new manufacturing plants to meet demand. Furthermore, he warned that individuals responsible for leaking information about military supplies will face investigations and potential imprisonment.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የአሜሪካ የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት እያለቀ ነው የሚሉ የዜና ዘገባዎችን ውድቅ አድርገዋል። አሜሪካ ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው የጦር መሳሪያ ክምችት እንዳላት እና የምርት መጠኑም እየጨመረ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ስለ ወታደራዊ አቅርቦቶች ሚስጥራዊ መረጃ የሚያወጡ አካላት ላይ ምርመራ እንደሚደረግና ከባድ የእስር ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቃቸው አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump gabaasawwan meeshaaleen waraanaa Ameerikaa dhumaa jiru jedhanii tamsaa'an kijiba jedheera. Ameerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa baay'ee akka qabduu fi oomishtummaanis yeroodhaa gara yerootti dabalaa akka jiru ibseera. Kana malees, odeeffannoo dhokataa kana kan baasan namoota irratti qorannoon akka godhamuu fi hidhaa cimaan akka eeggatu akeekkachiiseera.

title: Nearly 80% of US army's interceptors for a key missile defense system depleted: Report
english: A recent report reveals that the US military has significantly drained its supply of critical missile interceptors, with nearly 80 percent of its THAAD inventory used up. Military officials expressed concerns that stockpiles of air defense weapons, including Patriot interceptors, are reaching dangerously low levels. The rapid depletion of these essential resources is largely attributed to recent ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ ዘገባ እንደሚያመለክተው የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ለሚሳኤል መከላከያ የሚያገለግሉ ቁልፍ የጦር መሳሪያዎቹን በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተጠቅሞ ጨርሷል። በተለይም የ THAAD ሚሳኤል ክምችት ወደ 80 በመቶ ገደማ የቀነሰ ሲሆን የፓትሪዮት መከላከያ መሳሪያዎችም ግማሽ ያህሉ ጥቅም ላይ ውለዋል። ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት ይህ የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት አደገኛ ደረጃ ላይ መድረሱን በመግለጽ በቅርቡ በተፈጠሩ ግጭቶች ሳቢያ ክምችቱ መሟጠጡን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: gabaasi dhihoo kana ifa godhe akka agarsiisutti, waraanni Ameerikaa meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa kanaan dura qabu keessaa harka 80 ol ta'u akka itti fayyadame ibsa. Keessumattuu, meeshaaleen THAAD jedhaman harki guddaan erga dhumeen booda, kanneen Paatriyoot jedhaman keessaa immoo walakkaan isaanii dhumaniiru. Hoji geggeessitoonni waraana Ameerikaa, rakkoon meeshaalee waraanaa kun sadarkaa yaaddessaa irra akka ga'eefi kunis walitti bu'iinsa naannoo sanaa waliin wal qabatee kan uumame ta'uu beeksisaniiru.

title: Nearly 80% of US army's interceptors for a key missile defense system depleted: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the US military has significantly drained its supply of critical missile defense interceptors due to ongoing regional conflicts. Military officials have expressed alarm that inventory levels for THAAD and Patriot systems have dropped to dangerously low amounts. This depletion raises concerns about the country's current ability to maintain its defensive capabilities.
amharic: አንድ አዲስ ዘገባ እንደሚያመለክተው የአሜሪካ ጦር በተለያዩ ግጭቶች ምክንያት ወሳኝ የሆኑ የመከላከያ ሚሳኤሎቹን ክምችት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ተጠቅሞባቸዋል። ወታደራዊ ባለስልጣናት እንደ THAAD እና Patriot ያሉ የመከላከያ ስርዓቶች ክምችት ወደ አደገኛ ደረጃ ማሽቆልቆሉን ገልጸዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ የአገሪቱን የወቅቱን የመከላከል አቅም በተመለከተ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa tokko akka ibsutti, waraanni Ameerikaa walitti buiinsa naannichaa keessatti meeshaalee ittisa xiyyaaraa baay'ee fayyadamee dhumeera. Hojjettoonni waraanaa sirnoota ittisaa THAAD fi Patriot akkaan gadi bu'uun isaa balaaf akka saaxile ibsaniiru. Dhimmi kun amala ittisa biyyattii amma jiru irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Banned from football at home, Afghan women's team reunite 8,000 miles away
english: The Afghan women’s national football team has reunited in New Zealand for a training camp after being forced to flee their country due to Taliban restrictions. Following a landmark decision by FIFA allowing them to represent Afghanistan officially despite the current regime, the squad is now training together with hopes of qualifying for future international tournaments. This gathering marks a major milestone for the refugee athletes who have been living in various countries since 2021.
amharic: የአፍጋኒስታን የሴቶች ብሔራዊ እግር ኳስ ቡድን በታሊባን ገደብ ምክንያት ሀገራቸውን ለቀው ከወጡ በኋላ በኒውዚላንድ ዳግም ተገናኝተዋል። የፊፋ ውሳኔ ቡድኑ በአሁኑ አገዛዝ ስር ሆነውም በአለም አቀፍ መድረክ አፍጋኒስታንን እንዲወክሉ ከፈቀደላቸው በኋላ፣ ተጫዋቾቹ ወደፊት በዓለም ዋንጫ እና በኦሎምፒክ ለመሳተፍ ልምምድ ጀምረዋል። ከ2021 ጀምሮ በተለያዩ ሀገራት ተበታትነው የነበሩት እነዚህ ስደተኛ አትሌቶች ዳግም በአንድነት መሰባሰባቸው ትልቅ ተስፋን ፈንጥቋል።
oromo: Garee kubbaa miillaa dubartoota Afgaanistaan mootummaa Taaliibaan booda biyya isaanii gadhiisanii baqatanii turan, amma New Zealanditti wal-arganii leenjii jalqabaniiru. FIFA murtoo seenaa qabeessa dabarseen gareen kun mootummaa ammaa jiru osoo hin beekamin biyya isaanii bakka bu'anii akka taphatan hayyamameefii jira. Gareen kun gara fuulduraatti morkiiwwan addunyaa irratti hirmaachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru; kunis waggoota dheeraaf biyyoota gara garaa keessatti bittimanii kan turan atleetota kanaaf injifannoo guddaadha.

title: Could the Iran war derail Donald Trump’s legacy?
english: President Trump is attempting to reshape the public perception of the Iran conflict as the 2026 midterm elections approach. However, political analysts suggest that many voters view the ongoing involvement in the Middle East as ineffective and unhelpful to their daily lives. There is growing concern that this ongoing military entanglement could negatively impact Trump's political standing and historical legacy.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የ2026 የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫን ታሳቢ በማድረግ በኢራን ላይ ያላቸውን አቋም እና የጦርነቱን ሁኔታ ለመቀየር ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው። ይሁን እንጂ የፖለቲካ ተንታኞች እንደሚጠቁሙት፣ መራጮች በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ግጭት ህይወታቸውን ያላሻሻለ እና ፋይዳ ቢስ አድርገው ይመለከቱታል። ይህ ቀጣይነት ያለው ወታደራዊ ተሳትፎ በትራምፕ የፖለቲካ ምስል እና በታሪካዊ ስማቸው ላይ አሉታዊ ተጽእኖ ሊያሳድር እንደሚችል ስጋት አለ።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Tiraamp filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa 2026 dura waraana Iraan irratti qaban irratti yaada uummataa jijjiiruuf tattaaffii gochaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyonni siyaasaa akka ibsanitti, filattoonni waraana Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti taasifamaa jiru kun jireenya isaanii irratti jijjiirama gaarii akka hin fidin fi bu'aa akka hin qabne yaadu. Waraana kana keessatti hirmaachuun kun adeemsa siyaasaa Tiraampii fi seenaa isaa irratti dhiibbaa gadhee geessisuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama.

title: Trump administration refunds $100bn in tariffs struck down by Supreme Court
english: The Trump administration has returned approximately $100 billion to importers following a Supreme Court ruling that declared many of its trade tariffs unconstitutional. The Court determined that the President misused emergency powers to impose broad duties on numerous countries, leading to a legal mandate for the government to provide refunds. While these specific tariffs were overturned, other trade duties related to specific industries like steel and automobiles remain in effect.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የጣላቸውን በርካታ የንግድ ታሪፎች ሕገ-ወጥ ናቸው ብሎ መወሰኑን ተከትሎ፣ መንግሥት ወደ 100 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የሚጠጋ ክፍያ ለገዢዎች መለሰ። ፍርድ ቤቱ ፕሬዝዳንቱ ታሪፎቹን የጣሉበት መንገድ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ስልጣንን ያለአግባብ መጠቀም ነው ሲል ብይን ሰጥቷል። ምንም እንኳን እነዚህ የተወሰኑ ታሪፎች ቢሰረዙም፣ በብረት እና በመኪና ምርቶች ላይ የተጣሉት ሌሎች የንግድ ግዴታዎች አሁንም በሥራ ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mootummaan Trump murtee Mana Murtii Olaanaa Ameerikaa kaffaltii taarifii hedduu seeraan alaa ta’e jedhee murteesseen booda, qarshii biiliyoona 100 ol gabaaf deebiseera. Mana murtichaa kanaan dura pirezedantichi aangoosaa fayyadamee biyyoota hedduu irratti taarifii kaa’uunsaa sirrii akka hin taane ibseera. Taarifoonni kunneen haalamaniyyu, taarifoonni oomishaalee akka sibiilaa fi konkolaataa irratti kaa’aman garuu ammas hojii irra jiru.

title: Lightning strike kills Thai footballer during match
english: A football player in southern Thailand died instantly after being struck by lightning during a semi-final match. The incident occurred amidst a sudden monsoon storm that swept through the area. Additionally, twelve other people were injured as a result of the lightning strike.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ታይላንድ እየተካሄደ በነበረ የጥሎ ማለፍ የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ወቅት መብረቅ በመምታቱ አንድ ተጫዋች በቦታው ላይ ህይወቱ አልፏል። አደጋው የተከሰተው አካባቢውን ባጠቃው የሙቀት ንፋስ ዝናብ ወቅት ነው። በተጨማሪም በመብረቅ አደጋው ሌሎች አስራ ሁለት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል።
oromo: Taayilaand kibbaatti tapha kubbaa miillaa marsaa xumuraa duraa irratti, namni taphataa tokko bakakkaan rukutamee battalumatti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo obomboleettiin cimaan naannichatti roobaa turetti dha. Kana malees, bakakka kanaan walqabatee namoonni biraa kudha lamni miidhamaniiru.

title: How Gambian women are restoring the mangroves protecting Banjul
english: Women living near Banjul, The Gambia, are actively restoring mangrove forests in the Tanbi Wetland to protect their coastal communities from flooding and erosion. By planting thousands of trees, these women are reviving a vital ecosystem that serves as both a natural barrier and a source of food and income. This initiative highlights how local residents are taking environmental action to sustain their livelihoods and safeguard their homes.
amharic: በጋምቢያ ባንጁል አቅራቢያ የሚኖሩ ሴቶች የባህር ዳርቻ መንደሮቻቸውን ከጎርፍ እና ከመሬት መሸርሸር ለመከላከል የማንግሩቭ ደኖችን መልሰው በመትከል ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ሴቶች በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ችግኞችን በመትከል የተፈጥሮ መከላከያ የሆነውን እና ለኑሮአቸው መሠረት የሆነውን ስነ-ምህዳር እያነቃቁት ነው። ይህ ጥረት የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች የኑሮ ምንጫቸውን ለመጠበቅ እና አካባቢያቸውን ለመታደግ እያደረጉት ያለውን ጉልህ አስተዋጽኦ ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubartoonni magaalaa Baanjul, Gaambiyaa biratti argaman, naannawaan isaanii lolaa fi biyyoo dhiqamuurraa ittisuuf bosona maangiroovii deebisanii dhaabuuf hojjechaa jiru. Dubartoonni kun mukkeen kumaatamaan lakkaa'aman dhaabuun, naannawaa isaanii fi jireenya isaaniif bu'uura kan ta'e naannoo uumamaa kana fayyisuu danda'aniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun jiraattonni naannichaa jireenya isaanii eeggachuu fi naannoo isaanii balaarraa ittisuuf hirmaannaa godhan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Explosive-laden drone found at German airport hosting Ukrainian fleet
english: German authorities are investigating an incident where a drone loaded with explosives was discovered at Leipzig/Halle Airport. This airport is significant because it currently serves as the operational base for Ukraine’s Antonov Airlines following their relocation due to the Russian invasion. Officials are now working to determine how the device arrived there and who might be responsible for the security breach.
amharic: የጀርመን ባለስልጣናት ፈንጂ የተጫነበት ድሮን በሌይፕዚግ/ሃሌ አውሮፕላን ማረፊያ መገኘቱን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ አየር ማረፊያ በሩሲያ ወረራ ምክንያት ከተፈናቀለ በኋላ የዩክሬን አንቶኖቭ አየር መንገድ ዋና መነሻ ሆኖ በማገልገል ላይ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናቱ ፈንጂው እንዴት ወደዚያ እንደገባ እና ለዚህ የደህንነት ጥሰት ተጠያቂው ማን እንደሆነ ለማወቅ ጥረት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Jarmanii xiyyara nam-malee (drone) qarxii baasuun meeshaa waraanaa baachaa ture buufata xiyyaraa Leipzig/Halle keessatti argamuusaatiin qorannoo jalqabaniiru. Buufanni kun erga weerarri Raashiyaa eegalee booda, dhaabbanni xiyyaraa Yukreen 'Antonov Airlines' bakka buufataatti gargaaramuudha. Aangootonni kun meeshaaleen kun akkamitti achi akka ga'anii fi namoonni nageenya kana cabsani eenyu akka ta'an adda baasuuf hojjechaa jiru.

title: Netanyahu says Israel did not agree to US-backed Gaza plan
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has publicly rejected a Gaza peace proposal that was previously promoted by the United States. While President Trump had recently described this initiative as a significant step toward disarmament and troop withdrawals, Netanyahu stated that Israel never consented to the plan. This disagreement highlights a notable gap between the positions of the Israeli government and the American administration regarding the future of the region.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በአሜሪካ ድጋፍ የቀረበውን የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ እንደማይቀበሉት በይፋ አስታውቀዋል። ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ይህንን ዕቅድ ለጋዛ መረጋጋት ትልቅ ምዕራፍ እንደሆነ ቢገልጹም፣ ኔታንያሁ ግን እስራኤል ለዚህ ስምምነት ፈቃዷን እንዳልሰጠች ተናግረዋል። ይህ ክስተት በእስራኤል መንግሥት እና በአሜሪካ አስተዳደር መካከል በጋዛ ጉዳይ ላይ ያለውን ልዩነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyaamin Neetaanyaahuu karoora nageenya Gaazaa kan Ameerikaan deggerame fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsaniiru. Preezidaanti Doonaald Traamp karoora kana tarkaanfii guddaa gara nageenyaatti fidu jedhanii ibsanillee, Neetaanyaahuun garuu Israa'el waliigaltee kanaan walii hin galle jedhan. Wal-dhabdeen kun mootummaan Israa'elii fi bulchiinsi Ameerikaa gara fuulduraa Gaazaa irratti ilaalcha garaagaraa akka qaban agarsiisa.

title: Trump clashed with Hegseth over munition shortage amid war on Iran: Report
english: President Trump reportedly questioned Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth during a recent cabinet meeting regarding an unexpected shortage of military supplies during the conflict with Iran. This lack of munitions allegedly forced the President to temporarily halt major airstrikes against Iranian targets. While Hegseth attempted to deflect the blame onto his deputy, the White House has officially dismissed the entire report as false.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በኢራን ጦርነት ወቅት በተፈጠረው የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት ምክንያት የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በካቢኔ ስብሰባ ላይ መጠየቃቸው ተሰምቷል። ይህ የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረት በኢራን ላይ ታቅዶ የነበረውን መጠነ ሰፊ የአየር ጥቃት ለማቆም ምክንያት ሆኗል ተብሏል። ሄግሴት ጥፋቱን በምክትላቸው ላይ ለመጫን ቢሞክሩም፣ የኋይት ሀውስ ግን ዘገባውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp waraana Iraan waliin ta'een walqabatee meeshaaleen waraanaa akka hir'atan erga hubatanii booda, ministira ittisaa Piit Hegseth waliin falmii cimaa akka godhan gabaafameera. Hir'inni meeshaalee waraanaa kun akeekni tarkaanfii cimaa Iraan irratti fudhachuu turan akka dhaabbatu godheera jedhameera. Hegseth komii kana gargaaraa isaanii irratti qaxxaamuraa yoo ta'u, manni maree addaa (White House) garuu oduun kun dhugaa miti jechuun haaleera.

title: Vessel reports hearing two blasts in Hormuz Strait, UKMTO says
english: A tanker traveling through the Strait of Hormuz near Oman reported hearing two loud explosions on Wednesday. Authorities confirmed that the ship's crew is safe and there is no evidence of environmental harm. The incident is currently being monitored by maritime security officials.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ አንድ የነዳጅ መርከብ ሁለት ተከታታይ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙት ዘግቧል። የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን ኤጀንሲ የመርከቡ ሠራተኞች ደህና እንደሆኑ እና ምንም ዓይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመከሰቱን አረጋግጧል። ሁኔታው በባህር ላይ ደህንነት ባለሥልጣናት ክትትል እየተደረገበት ነው።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii darbe markabni boba'aa tokko bishaan Hormuz keessa utuu deemuu dhuka'a lama akka dhaga'e gabaaseera. Hojjettoonni markabichaa nagaa akka qaban fi miidhaan naannawaa irratti hin geenye qaamoleen nageenya galaana UKMTO mirkaneessaniiru. Ta'ichi ammatti qaamolee nageenyaatiin qoratamaa jira.

title: Footage shows Israeli forces beating Palestinian during raid
english: Israeli soldiers were filmed physically assaulting a Palestinian man during a military operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp in the West Bank on Wednesday. During the raid, troops searched multiple homes and occupied the camp's local committee office. While the Israeli military claimed the operation was aimed at suspected militants, they did not provide specific details or evidence for these actions.
amharic: ረቡዕ ዕለት በዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው ካላንዲያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ በተደረገ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ወቅት የእስራኤል ወታደሮች አንድ ፍልስጤማዊ ሰው ሲደበድቡ የሚያሳይ ምስል ተለቋል። በወረራው ወቅት ወታደሮቹ በርካታ ቤቶችን የፈተሹ ሲሆን የካምፑን የአካባቢ ኮሚቴ ዋና መሥሪያ ቤትም ተቆጣጥረው ነበር። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል ዘመቻው ያነጣጠረው በአሸባሪዎች ላይ ነው ቢልም፣ ለዚህ ድርጊታቸው በቂ ማብራሪያ ወይም ማስረጃ አላቀረቡም።
oromo: Guyyaa Roobii darbe, waraanni Israa'el qubata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan naannoo Lixaa keessatti argamu irratti duula gaggeessaniin, dhiirri tokko yeroo reebamu viidiyoon ittiin waraabamee gadhiifameera. Duula kana keessatti, waraanni Israa'el mana jireenyaa fi waajjira komitii naannichaa sakatta'anii jiru. Waraanni Israa'el duulli kun kan karoorfame qaamolee shororkeessitoota jedhaniin irratti ta'uus, ibsa quubsaa fi ragaa ifa ta'e garuu hin kennine.

title: Israeli rights group calls for independent health examination of Gaza doctor
english: Physicians for Human Rights Israel has petitioned the court to grant an independent doctor access to examine Hussam Abu Safiya, a Palestinian physician held without charges since late 2024. The doctor was arrested during a raid on Kamal Adwan Hospital in Gaza and has faced a severe decline in his medical condition while in detention. Activists and human rights organizations are now pressuring the Israeli authorities to authorize an external medical evaluation and are demanding his release.
amharic: የእስራኤል የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅት በቁጥጥር ስር የሚገኘው ፍልስጤማዊው ሀኪም ሁሳም አቡ ሳፊያ በገለልተኛ ዶክተር እንዲመረመሩ ለፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርቧል። ዶክተሩ በጋዛ በሚገኝ ሆስፒታል ላይ በተደረገ ወረራ በቁጥጥር ስር የዋሉ ሲሆን እስካሁን በይፋ የቀረበባቸው ክስ የለም። በእስር ላይ ሳሉ የጤና ሁኔታቸው በጣም እያሽቆለቆለ በመሄዱ ምክንያት፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ለሀኪሙ የህክምና እርዳታ እንዲደረግላቸው እና በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ እየጠየቁ ነው።
oromo: Dhaabbanni mirga namoomaa Israa'el, ogeessi fayyaa Paleshiin Dr. Hussam Abu Safiyaa mana hidhaa keessatti ogeessa fayyaa walaba ta'een akka qoratamaniif mana murtiitti iyyata galcheera. Doktichi bara 2024 gara dhumaa magaala Gaza keessatti erga qabamanii kaasee, himannaa tokko malee hidhamanii jiru. Yeroo ammaa haalli fayyaa isaanii baay'ee gad hir'achaa waan jiruuf, dhaabbileen mirga namoomaa walaba ta'an akka isaan fayyisaman fi hatattamaan akka gadhiifaman gaafachaa jiru.

title: Mamdani praises El-Sayed’s victory, rejects ‘mini Mamdani’ trope
english: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani has publicly congratulated Abdul El-Sayed on his success in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary. Mamdani commended the candidate’s commitment to addressing healthcare access and economic affordability. He also playfully brushed off Republican efforts to label El-Sayed as his political protégé, noting that the candidate is physically much stronger than him.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ከተማ ከንቲባ ዞህራን ማምዳኒ፣ አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ሴኔት የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ምርጫ በማሸነፋቸው እንኳን ደስ አላችሁ ብለዋል። ማምዳኒ የኤል-ሳየድን የጤና መድህን እና የኑሮ ውድነትን የመፍታት እቅድ አድንቀዋል። በተቃዋሚዎች የቀረበውን “የማምዳኒ አምሳያ” የሚል ስያሜም በቀልድ መልክ በመቀበል፣ ኤል-ሳየድ ከእርሳቸው የበለጠ የአካል ብቃት እንዳለው ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Niiwyoork Zohraan Maamdanii, Abdul El-Saayed filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimookiraatawaa kan Michigan irratti injifannoo argachuu isaaniitiif gammachuu qaban ibsaniiru. Maamdanii tarsiimoo El-Saayed kan tajaajila fayyaa fi gatii jireenyaa fooyyessuuf qaban kan dinqisiifatan yoo ta'u, maqaa warreen mormitootaa isaan irratti moggaasan kan tuffatan ta'uus eeraniiru. Akkasumas, El-Saayed humna qaamaa isaan irra caalu qabaachuun isaa qoosaadhaan dubbataniiru.

title: Iran war live: Tehran, Oman close in on Hormuz deal; Houthis attack tankers
english: Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement to establish designated shipping routes through the critical Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, the Houthi movement has carried out strikes against Saudi oil tankers amidst ongoing regional volatility. Despite these tensions, President Trump has expressed a preference for diplomatic negotiations with Tehran over military conflict.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በስትሬት ኦፍ ሆርሙዝ የባህር መስመር ላይ ለመስማማት ተቃርበዋል። በዚህ ወቅት የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳዑዲ ነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦች ላይ ጥቃት የሰነዘሩ ሲሆን፣ ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕም ከጦርነት ይልቅ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ችግሮችን መፍታት እንደሚመርጡ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Iiraan fi Omaan daandii markabaa kan iddoo Hormuz jedhamu irratti walii galtee dhumaa irra ga'aa jiru. Yeroo wal fakkaatuuttis, gareen Huutii markaboota boba'aa Sa'udii irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Taphni kun jiraatullee, pirezidaant Traamp waraana irra karaa dippiloomaasiitiin mari'achuun akka filatamaa ta'e ibsaniiru.

title: Mexican influencer shot dead during TikTok livestream
english: A popular Mexican TikTok influencer named Cesar Gastelum was shot and killed while recording a live video in the city of Culiacan. The attack, which was captured on camera, involved gunmen on a motorcycle who opened fire while he was sitting in a parking lot. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, noting that the victim had previously posted content referencing criminal groups in a region currently affected by violent cartel warfare.
amharic: ሲሳር ጋስቴሉም የተባለ ታዋቂ የቲክቶክ ተፅዕኖ ፈጣሪ በሜክሲኮ ኩሊያካን ከተማ በቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ እያለ በጥይት ተገድሏል። በቪዲዮው ላይ እንደሚታየው ሞተር ሳይክል ላይ የነበሩ ሁለት ታጣቂዎች ተጎጂው መኪና ማቆሚያ ቦታ ላይ ተቀምጦ ሳለ ተኩስ ከፍተውበት አምልጠዋል። በክልሉ ያለው የካርቴል ግጭት እና ተጎጂው ቀደም ሲል ስለ ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖች የሚያሳዩ ቪዲዮዎችን ይለቅ እንደነበር በመጥቀስ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Siizar Gaasteluum kan jedhamu fiix-toookerii beekamaan magaalaa Kuuliyaakaanitti yeroo viidiyoo qajjeelaa (livestream) waraabaa turetti ajjeefameera. Miidhaan kun viidiyoo irratti akka mul'atetti, namoonni lama mootorsayikilaan dhufanii yeroo inni bakka konkolaataan itti dhaabatu tokkotti taa'ee jiru bitaa fi mirgatti dhukaasaniiru. Aanaalee kana keessatti waraanni kartelootaa jiraachuu fi inni duraan viidiyoo garee yakkaatiin walqabatu gadhiisaa ture waan ta'eef, aangotootni qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Nigeria announces rescue of 308 kidnapped citizens
english: Nigerian security forces successfully rescued 308 citizens who had been held captive following separate attacks in Kwara and Niger states. The operation, led by the National Counter Terrorism Centre, marks the largest joint rescue effort conducted by the country to date. This mission provides a significant relief to the nation, which has been grappling with a rising crisis of mass kidnappings by armed criminal groups.
amharic: የናይጄሪያ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በኳራ እና በኒጀር ግዛቶች ታግተው የነበሩ 308 ዜጎችን በጋራ ኦፕሬሽን ነጻ አውጥተዋል። የሀገሪቱ የሽብር መከላከል ማዕከል የመራው ይህ ተልዕኮ፣ እስካሁን በሀገሪቱ ከተደረጉት ትልቁ የነጻ ማውጣት ስራ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል። ይህ ስኬታማ እርምጃ በታጣቂ ቡድኖች እየደረሰ ያለውን የጅምላ ታጋቾች ቀውስ ለመግታት ለሚደረገው ጥረት ትልቅ እፎይታን ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Naayijeeriyaa namoota 308 kutaa Kwaraa fi Nijer keessatti hidhamanii turan duula qindaa’een bilisa baasaniiru. Duulli kun kan hoogganame giddugala ittisa shororkeessummaa biyyattii tiin yoo ta’u, hojii nama baasuu hanga har’aatti biyyattii keessatti godhame keessaa isa guddaa dha. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti garee hidhattootaan namoota butuun dhibee ta’ee jiru hambisuuf shoora guddaa qaba.

title: FIFA pledges to defend Infantino after World Cup rights plan collapses
english: FIFA officials have reaffirmed their support for President Gianni Infantino following the collapse of a controversial plan to sell off World Cup commercial rights. The proposal sparked internal revolt and threats from major football confederations, leading FIFA to withdraw the deal and offer an apology. Despite calls for his resignation, FIFA leadership intends to defend Infantino's position and protect the organization's reputation against further criticism.
amharic: የፊፋ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች የዓለም ዋንጫ የንግድ መብቶችን ለመሸጥ ታቅዶ የነበረው አወዛጋቢ እቅድ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት ለፕሬዚዳንቱ ለጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ያላቸውን ድጋፍ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ፕሮፖዛል በተለያዩ አህጉራዊ የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞና ስጋት በመፍጠሩ ፊፋ እቅዱን ለመሰረዝ እና ይቅርታ ለመጠየቅ ተገዷል። የኢንፋንቲኖ ሥልጣን መልቀቅ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ቢጠየቅም፣ የፊፋ አመራር የፕሬዚዳንቱን ቦታ ለመከላከልና የተቋሙን ገጽታ ለመጠበቅ እንደሚሰሩ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni FIFA karoora mormii guddaa kaase kan mirga daldalaa Waancaa Addunyaa gurguruuf karoorame erga fashaleen booda, deggarsa isaanii Preezidaant Jiyaanii Infaantiinoof deebisanii ibsaniiru. Karoorri kun gamtaa kubbaa miilaa idil-addunyaa keessatti mormii fi soda guddaa waan uumeef, FIFA karooricha haquufi dhiifama gaafachuuf dirqameera. Infaantiinoo akka gad-lakkisan gaaffiin dhiyaatus, hoggantoonni FIFA bakka jireenya pirezidaantichaa ittisuufi maqaa dhaabbatichaa kabachiisuuf akka hojjetan beeksisaniiru.

title: Erica Schwartz confirmed as new CDC chief amid US agency turmoil
english: The US Senate has officially confirmed Dr. Erica Schwartz as the new director of the CDC following a period of significant leadership instability. Her appointment comes as the agency faces major internal challenges, including high staff turnover and ongoing public health crises like the measles outbreak. Supporters hope she will restore scientific integrity to the organization despite previous concerns about political interference.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴኔት ዶክተር ኤሪካ ሽዋርትዝን የሲዲሲ (CDC) አዲሱ ዳይሬክተር አድርጎ በይፋ መርጧል። ይህ ሹመት የተሰጠው ኤጀንሲው ከፍተኛ የሰራተኞች መውጣት እና የተለያዩ የጤና ቀውሶች እየገጠሙት ባለበት ወቅት ነው። ምንም እንኳን ቀደም ሲል የፖለቲካ ተፅዕኖ ይኖራል የሚል ስጋት ቢኖርም፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች እርሳቸው በሳይንሳዊ መርሆዎች ላይ በመመስረት ተቋሙን እንዲያረጋጉ ተስፋ አድርገዋል።
oromo: Mana maree Yunaayitid Isteetesitti, Doktar Eerikaa Shwaarts dareektara haaraa CDC ta'anii muudamuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru. Muudamni kun kan dhufu, dhaabbatichi rakkoo hojjettootaa fi dhibee fayyaa biyyoolessaa irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru keessa darbaa jirutti. Shakkii siyaasaa duraan ture irra darbuun, Doktar Eerikaan amanamummaa saayinsii deebisuudhaan dhaabbaticha tasgabbeessu jedhamee eeggama.

title: Trump says he would prefer a deal with Iran to further military action
english: President Trump stated that he favors a diplomatic agreement with Iran rather than engaging in military conflict. He mentioned that the U.S. had planned a major strike against Iran but paused after receiving a request for negotiations, emphasizing his goal of preventing them from developing nuclear weapons. Despite his comments, Iranian officials have denied that any recent discussions between the two nations have occurred.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር በወታደራዊ ግጭት ከመግባት ይልቅ በድርድር መፍትሄ ማምጣትን እንደሚመርጡ ገለጹ። አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ትልቅ ጥቃት ለመሰንዘር አቅዳ እንደነበረ ቢገልጹም፣ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ለድርድር ጥያቄ ካቀረቡ በኋላ እቅዱን ማቆማቸውን አስረድተዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ሰሞኑን ከአሜሪካ ጋር ምንም አይነት ድርድር አለማድረጋቸውን አስተባብለዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp waliigalteen diippilomaasii waraana irra akka caalu ibsuun, Iran waliin marii gochuun akka isaaniif wayyu dubbataniiru. Ameerikaan Iran irratti haleellaa gurguddaa gaggeessuuf qophii turus, mootummaan Iran mariif gaaffii dhiyeessuun isaanii haleellicha akka dhaabsise himaniiru. Ta’us, mootummaan Iran guyyoota darban keessa Ameerikaa waliin mariin tokkollee akka hin taane ibsuun odeeffannoo kana haalaniiru.

title: Fifa admits mistakes but Infantino remains president
english: Gianni Infantino will continue to serve as the president of FIFA despite facing heavy criticism for a controversial plan to sell stakes in football tournaments to private investors. While FIFA leadership officially acknowledged that mistakes were made during the handling of this proposal and apologized for excluding key members, they have formally reaffirmed their support for his presidency. The organization promised to improve its transparency to prevent similar issues from recurring in the future.
amharic: የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ለውድድሮች የሽያጭ እቅድ ተቃውሞ ቢገጥማቸውም በስልጣናቸው ይቀጥላሉ። ፊፋ በሂደቱ ላይ ስህተቶች እንደነበሩ አምኖ ይቅርታ የጠየቀ ቢሆንም፣ የድርጅቱ ከፍተኛ አመራሮች ለኢንፋንቲኖ ያላቸውን ሙሉ ድጋፍ አረጋግጠዋል። ወደፊት ተመሳሳይ ስህተቶችን ላለመድገም እና ግልጽነትን ለማስፈን ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Pirezidantiin FIFA Janni Infantino karoora dorgommii kubbaa miilaa irratti qaban irratti mormiin cimaan isaan mudatus, hoggansa isaanii itti fufuuf murteessaniiru. FIFA rakkoolee fi dogoggora adeemsicha keessatti uumame fudhachuun dhiifama gaafateera; ta'us, hoggantoonni olaanoon deeggarsa guutuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Dhaabbatichi gara fuulduraatti iftoomina dabaluuf fi dogoggora akkasii irra deebii dhabamsiisuuf waadaa galeera.

title: Israeli occupation destroys farmland and lives in southern Syria
english: Israeli military operations in southern Syria are causing significant harm to the local agricultural sector by destroying farmland and blocking access through chemical contamination and bulldozing. These actions have severely worsened the regional hunger crisis, which is already exacerbated by a dramatic decrease in international aid. As a result, farmers are facing both the loss of their livelihoods and physical detention by occupying forces.
amharic: በደቡብ ሶሪያ የሚገኙ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች የግብርና መሬቶችን በማውደም እና መሬቱ እንዳይለማ በማድረግ በህዝቡ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሱ ነው። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ቀድሞውንም በረሃብ ለሚሰቃየው የሶሪያ ህዝብ ሁኔታውን የከፋ ያደረጉት ሲሆን፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የዕርዳታ አቅርቦት በግማሽ መቀነሱ ቀውሱን አባብሶታል። በዚህም የተነሳ አርሶ አደሮች ከኑሮ ምንጫቸው ተፈናቅለዋል እንዲሁም ለቁጥጥር እየተዳረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'el kibba Suuriyaatti qonnaa fi lafa qonnaa mancaasuun akkasumas keemikaalaan faaluun qonnaan bultoota lafa isaanii irraa dhowwataa jira. Gochi kun rakkoo beelaa biyyattii keessatti bal'inaan jiru kan hammaate yoo ta'u, gargaarsi idil-addunyaa hir'achuun isaa immoo rakkoo kana caalatti hammaachiiseera. Haala kanaan qonnaan bultoonni lafa qonnaa isaanii dhabuun alatti, humnoota kanaan hidhaa fi miidhaan irratti raawwatamaa jira.

title: US officials push back on reports of dangerously low munitions supplies
english: The US government is denying claims that its military is running out of crucial weapons and defense interceptors following five months of conflict with Iran. While experts suggest that high usage of systems like Patriot and THAAD has left the nation's stockpiles dangerously low, the White House and the Pentagon maintain that their military capabilities remain robust. President Trump stated that the country has more than enough munitions and is currently working to increase production to support both US operations and international allies.
amharic: ከኢራን ጋር ከተካሄደው የአምስት ወር ጦርነት በኋላ የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ የጦር መሳሪያዎች እና የመከላከያ ሚሳኤሎች እያለቀባቸው ነው የሚለውን ዘገባ የአሜሪካ መንግስት አስተባብሏል። ምንም እንኳን ባለሙያዎች እንደ ፓትሪዮት እና ታድ ያሉ የጸረ-አየር መቃወሚያዎች ክምችት መቀነሱ ስጋት ፈጥሯል ቢሉም፣ ዋይት ሀውስ እና የፔንታጎን ሰራተኞች ግን የሀገሪቱ የጦር አቅም በቂ እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከማንም በላይ የጦር መሳሪያ እንዳላት እና ምርትን በመጨመር ለራሷም ሆነ ለወዳጅ ሀገራት ድጋፍ ለማድረግ እየሰሩ መሆናቸውን ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa waraana Iran waliin ji'a shaniif gaggeeffame kanaan walqabatee meeshaaleen waraanaa fi qolannoon xiyyaaraa ittisoo ta'an akka itti hir'atan gabaasame haaleera. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti fayyadama meeshaalee 'Patriot' fi 'THAAD' baay'achuu isaatiin hidhannoon biyyattii gadi bu'uu isaa ibsanis, Mana Maree (White House) fi Penteagon-ni garuu humna waraanaa isaanii amanamoo akka ta'e mirkaneessaniiru. Preezdaant Traamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan meeshaalee waraanaa gahaa qabaachuu ishee fi oomisha dabaluudhaan biyyoota michoota ta'an gargaaruuf karoorfachuu ishee ibsaniiru.

title: US man arrested at Trump’s golf course charged with multiple felonies
english: A former US Marine named Jeanine John Taele has been arrested after posing as a security agent at a golf course owned by Donald Trump in California. Authorities discovered illegal firearms, a fake badge, and disturbing notes inside his vehicle and residence. He is currently facing multiple felony charges and is being held in jail while legal proceedings continue.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ወታደር ዣኒን ጆን ታኤል በካሊፎርኒያ በሚገኘው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጎልፍ ሜዳ ላይ የጥበቃ ሰራተኛ መስሎ በመገኘቱ ተይዟል። ባለስልጣናት በተሽከርካሪው እና በመኖሪያ ቤቱ ውስጥ ህገ-ወጥ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን፣ የውሸት መታወቂያ እና አጠራጣሪ ማስታወሻዎችን አግኝተዋል። ግለሰቡ በአሁኑ ወቅት በበርካታ ከባድ የወንጀል ክሶች ተጠያቂ ሆኖ በእስር ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Ajajaa waraana US durii kan ta'e Jeanine John Taele, dirree gólfii Donald Trump kan Kaalifoorniyaa jiru keessatti ofii isaa akka eegduutti (security agent) of fakkeesee argamuun isaa booda to'annoo jala ooleera. Qondaalonni konkolaataa isaa fi mana isaa keessatti meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa, boojjii sobaa fi barreeffamoota nama yaaddessan argataniiru. Amma yakka ulfaataa hedduun himatamee mana hidhaa keessatti argama.

title: Israeli forces raid camp in occupied West Bank
english: Israeli military forces have carried out a major operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp located in the occupied West Bank. Reports indicate that soldiers assaulted Palestinian residents and arrested a number of individuals during the raid. The situation remains tense as the security forces continue their activities in the area.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው ካላንዲያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ውስጥ ትልቅ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ አካሂደዋል። በዘመቻው ወቅት ወታደሮቹ በፓለስታይን ነዋሪዎች ላይ ጥቃት የፈጸሙ ሲሆን፣ በርካታ ሰዎችንም በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። በካምፑ ያለው ሁኔታ አሁንም ከፍተኛ ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el qubsuma baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan naannoo Wiyist Baank jiru keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeessaniiru. Duula kanaanis, waraanni kun jiraattota Filisxeemii irratti miidhaa kan geessisan yoo ta'u, namoota muraas qabanii hidhaniiru. Haalli naannichaa amma yeroo ammaa qilleensa wal-dhabdee keessa jira.

title: Clashes on anniversary of Imran Khan imprisonment
english: Supporters of Pakistan’s former Prime Minister Imran Khan clashed with police in Rawalpindi while marking the third anniversary of his incarceration. Authorities deployed tear gas to disperse the crowds amidst tight security measures. The incident highlights ongoing political tensions surrounding the imprisoned leader.
amharic: የፓኪስታን የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ኢምራን ኻን የታሰሩበትን ሶስተኛ ዓመት ምክንያት በማድረግ ደጋፊዎቻቸው በራዋልፒንዲ ከተማ ከተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ጋር በተያያዘ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። የፀጥታ ኃይሎች ሰልፈኞቹን ለመበተን የለቅሶ ጭስ የተጠቀሙ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ጥብቅ የፀጥታ ቁጥጥር ተደርጓል። ይህ ክስተት የታሰረውን መሪ በሚመለከት በሀገሪቱ ያለውን የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Deeggartoonni muummee ministiraa duraanii Paakistaan Imraan Khaan, hidhaa isaanii waggaa sadaffaa sababeeffachuun magaalaa Raawaalpindii keessatti poolisoota waliin walitti bu'iinsa uumaniiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa namoota kana bittinneessuuf gaazii imimmaan fiduu fayyadamaniru. Walitti bu'iinsi kun haala siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti hoogganaa hidhamanii jiran kana irratti jiru kan calaqqisuudha.

title: Israeli military chief says army will continue Gaza operations despite peace plan
english: Israeli military official Eyal Zamir has announced that the army intends to maintain its active operations within Gaza to ensure the safety of Israeli citizens. This declaration was made shortly after international representatives requested that Israel suspend its military actions in the region. Despite ongoing peace efforts led by the U.S., the military maintains that these continued operations are necessary to neutralize security threats.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ መሪ ኤያል ዛሚር የእስራኤልን ዜጎች ደህንነት ለመጠበቅ በማሰብ በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው ዓለም አቀፍ ተወካዮች እስራኤል ጥቃቷን እንድታቆም ከጠየቁ ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። በአሜሪካ የሚመራው የሰላም ጥረት ቢኖርም፣ እስራኤል የጸጥታ ስጋቶችን ለመከላከል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዋን እንደምትቀጥል አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Ajajaan waraana Israa'el Eyal Zamir, nageenya lammiilee Israa'el eeguuf jecha duulli waraana Gaza keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru itti fufuu akka qabu ibseera. Ibsi kun kan ba'e, bakka buutonni idil-addunyaa Israa'el weerara ishee akka dhaabdu gaafatanii guyyoota muraasa booda dha. Caalbaasii nagaa kan Ameerikaan durfamuu keessattiillee, Israa'el sodaa nageenyaa hir'isuuf jecha tarkaanfiin waraanaas itti fufuu akka qabu ibsiteetti.

title: Turkish Foreign Minister warns Israeli expansionism could cause global crisis
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan has accused Israel of pursuing expansionist policies while rejecting peace efforts. He warned that if the international community fails to address these actions, the resulting instability could escalate into a worldwide crisis. These comments were made during regional discussions held in Jordan regarding the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን እስራኤል ለሰላም ፍላጎት እንደሌላት እና የግዛት መስፋፋት ፖሊሲን እየተከተለች እንደሆነ ከሰሱ። ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ይህንን አካሄድ ለመግታት እርምጃ ካልወሰደ፣ ግጭቱ ከአካባቢው አልፎ ዓለም አቀፍ ቀውስ ሊያስከትል እንደሚችል አስጠንቅቀዋል። ይህን አስተያየት የሰጡት በዮርዳኖስ የአረብ አገራት ተወካዮች ጋር በጋዛ ጉዳይ ላይ ውይይት ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Turkiyaa Hakan Fidan, Israa'el fedhii nagaa akka hin qabnee fi siyaasa babal'ifannaa biyyaa gaggeessaa akka jirtu himatan. Hawaasni idil-addunyaa tarkaanfii gahaa fudhachuu baannaan, rakkoon kun naannawaa qofa osoo hin taane, guddina gara fuulduraatti gara guddina addunyaatti ce'uu akka danda'u akeekkachiisaniiru. Yaada kana kan kennan marii biyyoota Arabaa waliin magaalaa Ammanitti dhimma Gazaarratti erga gaggeessanii booda dha.

title: Israeli military says it accidentally launched an interceptor after misidentifying its own military fire
english: The Israeli military recently fired an interceptor missile by mistake after incorrectly identifying its own active fire in southern Lebanon as a threat. Fortunately, there were no reported casualties resulting from this error. The military is currently conducting an official investigation into the circumstances surrounding the incident.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ያካሄደውን የራሱን የተኩስ ልውውጥ በስህተት የጠላት ጥቃት መስሎ በመታየቱ የመከላከያ ሚሳኤል ተኩሷል። በዚህ ድርጊት የተነሳ ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው የለም። ወታደራዊው ተቋም በስህተቱ ዙሪያ ምርመራ እያደረገ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el kibba Libaanoositti xiyyaara ofii isaanii dogoggoran xiyyaara diinaatti waan lakkaawaniif, xiyyaara ittisaa (interceptor) nutti darbatanii jiru. Haala kanaan miidhaan namarra gahe hin jiru. Waraanni Israa'el haala mudannoo kanaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa akka jiru beekameera.

title: Palestinian, Egyptian foreign ministers meet to discuss occupied Jerusalem
english: The Palestinian and Egyptian foreign ministers held a meeting in Amman to coordinate international efforts against recent Israeli actions in occupied Jerusalem. The discussion focused on urging Arab nations to pressure the United States to better protect Palestinian rights. Egypt reaffirmed its ongoing commitment to supporting the establishment of a Palestinian state during these talks.
amharic: የፍልስጤም እና የግብፅ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በተያዘው የኢየሩሳሌም ጉዳይ ላይ ዓለም አቀፍ ጫና ለመፍጠር በአማን ተገናኝተው ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ ያተኮረው የአረብ ሀገራት በአሜሪካ ላይ ተጽዕኖ በመፍጠር የፍልስጤማውያንን መብት እንዲያስከብሩ ጥሪ ለማቅረብ ነው። በዚህ ወቅት ግብፅ የፍልስጤም መንግሥት የመመስረት ጥያቄን እንደምትደግፍ ዳግም አረጋግጣለች።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa Falasxiin fi Misir magaalaa Ammanitti walga'uun, tarkaanfii Israa'el magaalaa Yerusaalem keessatti fudhattee ilaalchisee yaada wal jijjiiraniiru. Mareen kun biyyoonni Arabaa mootummaa Ameerikaa irratti dhiibbaa gochuun mirga Falasxiinotaa akka kabajchiisan taasisuu irratti xiyyeeffata. Misir, yeroo kanatti dhaabbata biyya Falasxiin hundeessuuf deeggarsa gootu cimsitee ibsiteetti.

title: After Michigan upset, Aipac looks to back Republican candidate against Abdul El-Sayed
english: Following Abdul El-Sayed's surprise victory in the Michigan Democratic Senate primary, the pro-Israel lobbying group Aipac has announced it will shift its financial support to the Republican candidate for the general election. Despite Aipac and other groups spending over $30 million to defeat him, El-Sayed won the election by a slim margin, highlighting a growing tension between establishment political funding and grassroots progressive movements. This shift confirms that Aipac prioritizes its specific policy goals over party loyalty by backing any candidate who aligns with their agenda.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ በሚቺጋን የዴሞክራቲክ ሴኔት የመጀመሪያ ምርጫ ባስመዘገቡት ያልተጠበቀ ድል ምክንያት፣ እስራኤልን የሚደግፈው የሎቢ ቡድን አይፓክ (Aipac) ለጠቅላላ ምርጫው የሪፐብሊካን እጩን እንደሚደግፍ አስታውቋል። አይፓክ እና ሌሎች ተቋማት እሱን ለማሸነፍ ከ30 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ቢያወጡም፣ ኤል-ሰይድ በትንሽ ልዩነት ማሸነፋቸው በተቋማት የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እና በህዝባዊ የለውጥ ንቅናቄዎች መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት አሳይቷል። ይህ እርምጃ አይፓክ ለአንድ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ከመቆም ይልቅ፣ ከዓላማው ጋር የሚስማማ እጩን መደገፍ እንደሚያስቀድም ያሳያል።
oromo: Abduul El-Sayed filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimookraataa kan Michigan irratti injifannoo ajaa'ibaa erga galmeessee booda, gareen lobiidhaan Israel deegguru Aipac, filannoo waliigalaa irratti kaadhimamaa paartii Rippaabilikaanii deeggara akka jedhe beeksiseera. Aipac fi gareewwan biroon isa mo'achuuf qarshii miliyoona 30 ol baasanii kan turan ta'us, El-Sayed injifachuun isaa dhiibbaa maallaqaa fi sochii hawaasaa gidduu jiru ifa godheera. Tarkaanfiin kun Aipac ejjennoo siyaasaa isaa kabajchiisuuf jecha, paartii tokkorra kaadhimamaa yaada isaa fudhatu mara akka deeggaru kan mirkaneessudha.

title: Iran says it has agreed Strait of Hormuz shipping route with Oman
