english: Iran has reached a preliminary agreement with Oman to establish a temporary shipping route through the Strait of Hormuz. Iranian officials noted that while this route is nearly finalized, they argue that full security cannot be guaranteed as long as the United States maintains a blockade on Iranian ports. The strait has remained largely closed since February, causing global energy market instability and leading to intense diplomatic pressure for its reopening.
amharic: ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ጊዜያዊ የመርከብ መስመር ለመክፈት ከኦማን ጋር መግባባት ላይ መድረሷን አስታውቃለች። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ይህ መስመር የመጨረሻ ምዕራፍ ላይ ቢሆንም፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ወደቦች ላይ ማዕቀብ እስካደረገች ድረስ የተሟላ የደህንነት ዋስትና ሊኖር እንደማይችል ገልጸዋል። ከየካቲት ወር ጀምሮ ይህ የባህር መስመር በመዘጋቱ የዓለም የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ከፍተኛ መዋዠቅ ታይቷል፣ ይህም ለቀጣናዊ ውጥረት ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Iiraan karaa markaboolee harka Hormuz irra darban ilaalchisee biyya Omaaniin waliigaltee gochuushee ibsiteetti. Hojjettoonni mootummaa Iiraan akka jedhanitti, daandichi xumura irra jiraatus, hanga Ameerikaan buufataaleen Iiraan irratti uggura taasisteetti jirtutti tasgabbii guutuu argachuun akka hin danda'amne himaniiru. Karaan kun guraandhala irraa jalqabee waan cufameef, gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti jijjiirama guddaa fidee jira.

title: El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary
english: Abdul El-Sayed has emerged victorious in Michigan’s Democratic Senate primary after defeating opponent Haley Stevens. This race was highly anticipated as it highlighted significant internal disagreements within the Democratic Party. Key issues driving the competition included differing perspectives on the United States' approach to the conflict in Israel.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ በገጠሙት ፉክክር ሃሌይ ስቲቨንስን በማሸነፍ በሚቺጋን የዴሞክራቲክ ሴኔት ምርጫ አሸናፊ ሆነዋል። ይህ የምርጫ ውድድር በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለውን የውስጥ የፖለቲካ ልዩነት ያሳየ በመሆኑ ከፍተኛ ትኩረት ተሰጥቶት ነበር። በውድድሩ ወቅት በኢስራኤል ጉዳይ ላይ ያለው የአሜሪካ አቋም ዋነኛው የክርክር መነሻ ሆኖ ነበር።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed injifannoo argachuun filannoo senetii Demokraatawaa kan biyya Michigan injifateera. Wal dorgommiin kun garee Demokraatawaa keessatti garaagarummaa yaadaa jiru kan mul’ise ta’uun isaa xiyyeeffannoo guddaa argateera. Dhimmi gurguddaan dorgommii kana keessatti ka’e keessaa tokko ilaalcha biyyi Ameerikaa walitti bu’iinsa Israa’eel irratti qabduudha.

title: US announces more than $100m in rewards for eight Jalisco cartel leaders
english: The U.S. government has launched a $102 million reward program for information leading to the capture of eight leaders from the Jalisco New Generation Cartel. This initiative is part of the Trump administration's broader strategy to combat Mexican cartels, which are now officially designated as foreign terrorist organizations. Authorities aim to dismantle these groups to stop the flow of illegal narcotics like fentanyl and cocaine into the United States.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የጃሊስኮ ኒው ጀነሬሽን ካርቴል የተባለውን ቡድን ስምንት መሪዎች ለመያዝ የሚያግዝ መረጃ ለሚሰጥ ሰው እስከ 102 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚደርስ ሽልማት እንደሚያበረክት አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ሜክሲኮ ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀሱ የወንጀል ቡድኖችን እንደ አሸባሪ ድርጅት በመፈረጅ የሚያደርገው የማጥቂያ ስልት አካል ነው። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት ወደ አሜሪካ የሚገቡ እንደ ፌንታኒል እና ኮኬይን ያሉ አደገኛ አደንዛዥ ዕጾችን ለመቆጣጠር ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa hogganoota garee yakka 'Jalisco New Generation Cartel' kan ta'an saddeet qabachuuf gargaaruu danda'uuf badhaasa doolaara miiliyoona 102 akka kennu beeksiseera. Tarkaanfiin kun tarsiimoo bulchiinsi Trump gareewwan yakka Maayikisiikootti argaman akkuma shororkeessitootaatti lakkaa'ee itti fayyadamuuf qabatee jiru keessaa isa tokko. Abbootiin taayitaa tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan, gara Ameerikaatti guuramaa jiran qoricha sammuu namaa hadoochan akka feentaanii fi kookeeyinii to'achuufi.

title: Iran says Hormuz talks with Oman in ‘final’ stages as route approved
english: Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement to establish a new, secure transit route for commercial ships through the Strait of Hormuz. The two nations have already finalized the geographical coordinates for this path, which will pass through both of their territorial waters. Officials hope this arrangement will stabilize shipping, provided that other countries do not interfere with the process.
amharic: ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ በኩል ለንግድ መርከቦች የሚያገለግል አዲስና ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ የመተላለፊያ መስመር ለመዘርጋት የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የባህር መንገዱን መጋጠሚያዎች በጋራ ተስማምተው ያጠናቀቁ ሲሆን፣ መንገዱም በሁለቱም ሀገራት የባህር ክልል ውስጥ የሚያልፍ ይሆናል። ሌሎች ወገኖች ጣልቃ ካልገቡ በስተቀር፣ ይህ ስምምነት የባህር ትራንስፖርትን አስተማማኝ ለማድረግ እንደሚረዳ ባለስልጣናቱ ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Iraanii fi Omaaniin daandii geejjiba daldalaa amansiisaa ta'e kan Hormuz keessatti banuuf waliigaltee xumuraa irra gahaa jiru. Biyyoonni lamaanuu kutaalee daandii kanaa irratti walii galanii jiran, daandichis naannoo bishaanota biyyoota lamaanii keessaan kan darbu ta'a. Mootummoonni kunniin, biyyoonni sadaffaan dhimma kana keessa yoo hin seenne, daandii kana banuun imala dooniiwwan daldalaa tasgabbaa'aa akka taasisu abdii qabu.

title: What’s behind US Representative Massie’s claims over crisis at Ceuta?
english: US Representative Thomas Massie has questioned the motives behind a recent mass migration event at the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in Morocco. He specifically criticized a US congressional report that seems to support Morocco's territorial claims over the enclave while recommending continued military funding for the country. Although some suggest the border incident was a deliberate attempt to pressure the Spanish government, these claims currently lack concrete evidence.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ተወካይ ቶማስ ማሲ በሞሮኮ በሚገኘው የሴኡታ ግዛት በተፈጠረው የድንበር ጥሰት ክስተት ላይ ጥያቄዎችን አንስተዋል። በተለይም የአሜሪካ ኮንግረስ ያወጣው ሪፖርት ለሞሮኮ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ድጋፍ እንደሚሰጥ በመግለጽ፣ ለሀገሪቱ የሚሰጠው ወታደራዊ እርዳታ እንዲቀጥል መደረጉን ተችተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ይህ የድንበር ክስተት የስፔንን መንግስት ለማሸማቀቅ የታቀደ ሴራ ነው የሚል ግምት ቢኖርም፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ይህንን የሚያረጋግጥ በቂ ማስረጃ የለም።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan mootummaa Ameerikaa Thomas Massie, naannoo Ceuta kan biyya Morookoo keessatti dhiheenya kana rakkoo godaantotaa uumame irratti gaaffii qaban kaasee jira. Innis gabaasa kutaalee kongiresii Ameerikaa tokko kan biyyi Morookoo naannoo sana irratti qabu deggeru fakkaatu fi deeggarsa waraanaa itti fufuuf gorsa kennu irratti komii qaba. Ta'us, rakkoon kun mootummaa Ispeen irratti dhiibbaa uumuuf yaadamee kan raawwatame ta'uu isaa irratti shakkii jiruuf hanga ammaatti ragaan qabatamaan hin argamne.

title: SpaceX shares slide on the heels of first quarterly report
english: SpaceX shares dropped over 13% after the company’s first quarterly report revealed much higher-than-expected spending on artificial intelligence infrastructure. Investors are concerned about these massive costs and whether they will produce significant financial returns. While the company's Starlink satellite internet business continues to grow profitably, shareholders remain cautious as a large number of restricted shares are set to become available for sale soon.
amharic: የስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) አክሲዮኖች የመጀመሪያ የሩብ ዓመት ሪፖርታቸውን ይፋ ካደረጉ በኋላ ከ13 በመቶ በላይ ቀንሰዋል። ኩባንያው በአርቴፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ያወጣው ከፍተኛ ወጪ ከገበያ ተንታኞች ግምት በላይ በመሆኑ ባለሀብቶች ስጋት ገብቷቸዋል። የኩባንያው የስታርሊንክ የኢንተርኔት አገልግሎት ጥሩ ትርፍ እያስገኘ ቢሆንም፣ በቅርቡ የሚለቀቁ ተጨማሪ የአክሲዮን ድርሻዎች በገበያው ላይ ተጨማሪ ተፅዕኖ ይኖራቸዋል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Qoodni qabeenyaa kampanii SpaceX gabaasa raajii isa duraa booda dhibbeentaa 13 olin gad bu'eera. Kunis kan ta'e, kampaniin kun fooyyessa teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' irratti baasii eeggamerraa ol baasuun isaa invastoroota waan yaaddesseefidha. Tajaajilli interneetaa Starlink faayidaa argamsiisaa kan jiru ta'us, dhiyeenyatti qoodni qabeenyaa dabalataa gabaa irratti gadhiifamuuf waan jiruuf, shakkii invastorootaa daran dabaleera.

title: Israel strikes south Lebanon after first evacuation warning in weeks
english: Israel conducted military strikes in southern Lebanon after accusing Hezbollah of violating a ceasefire agreement. One person was killed and several others injured when a prayer hall was hit in the town of Tibnin, while an evacuation order was issued for the town of Mansouri. These actions represent the first such warnings in over a month, occurring despite ongoing international efforts to maintain a fragile truce.
amharic: እስራኤል ሄዝቦላህ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቱን ጥሷል በሚል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃት ፈጽማለች። በትብኒን ከተማ በደረሰ የቦምብ ድብደባ አንድ ሰው ሲሞት ሌሎች በርካቶች ቆስለዋል፤ እንዲሁም በማንሱሪ ከተማ ነዋሪዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ትዕዛዝ ተላልፏል። እነዚህ ለወራት ታይተው የማይታወቁ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች የተወሰዱት ግጭቱን ለማስቆም ዓለም አቀፍ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ባለበት ወቅት ነው።
oromo: Israa'el gareen Hizbullaah waliigaltee dhaabbii waraana cabseera jechuun kibba Libanonirratti haleellaa raawwatteetti. Magaalaa Tibniinitti bakki kadhannaa rukutamuu isaatiin namni tokko yoo du'u, namoonni biroon hedduun madaa'aniiru akkasumas jiraattonni magaalaa Mansuurii akka gadi lakkisan ajajameera. Tarkaanfiin kun ji'a tokko keessatti kan jalqabaa yoo ta'u, kunis ta'e kan raawwatame waligaltee nagaa kabachiisuuf carraaqqii addunyaa gochaa jiran keessatti dha.

title: New Mexico sues US Justice Department for impeding Epstein probe
english: The state of New Mexico has launched a lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice, alleging that federal officials are intentionally blocking access to essential records regarding Jeffrey Epstein. Attorney General Raul Torrez claims these unredacted documents are vital for investigating potential crimes and identifying victims at Epstein’s former Zorro Ranch property. While federal authorities argue that privacy laws prohibit them from releasing the information, the state maintains that this refusal is obstructing the path to justice for survivors.
amharic: የኒው ሜክሲኮ ግዛት የፌደራል መንግሥት በጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን ላይ እየተደረገ ያለውን ምርመራ አደናቅፏል በሚል የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴርን ከሰሰ። የኒው ሜክሲኮ አቃቤ ህግ ራውል ቶሬዝ እንደሚሉት፣ ሚኒስቴሩ በኤፕስታይን የቀድሞ ንብረት በሆነው ዞሮ እርሻ ውስጥ የተፈጸሙ የወንጀል ድርጊቶችን ለማጣራት የሚያስፈልጉ ወሳኝ መረጃዎችን መደበቁ ምርመራውን እያስተጓጎለ ነው። በበኩሉ የፍትህ ሚኒስቴሩ የግላዊነት ህጎችን በመጥቀስ መረጃውን ለመስጠት ፈቃደኛ አልሆነም፤ ግዛቱ ግን ይህ አካሄድ ለተጎጂዎች የሚገባውን ፍትህ እያዘገየ ነው ሲል ይከራከራል።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo Niiw Meeksiikoo qorannoo nama yakka saal-qunnamtii raawwate Jefrii Episteeyin irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru gufachiiste jechuun Ministeera Haqaa Ameerikaa himateera. Abbaan Alangaa naannichaa Raawul Tooreez akka jedhanitti, ministeerichi qabeenya Episteeyin kan ture 'Zorro Ranch' keessatti yakka raawwatame adda baasuuf gargaaru kan jedhaman galmeewwan barbaachisoo dhoksaa jira. Ministeerichi seera iccitii eeguu waan jedhuun ragaalee kana kennuu diduun isaa, miidhamtootaaf haqni akka hin argamne gufachiisaa jira jechuun mootummaan naannichaa himata isaa dhiyeesseera.

title: Young pilot makes daring emergency landing on Florida interstate
english: A 21-year-old flight instructor successfully landed her small plane on an interstate highway in Florida after experiencing mechanical issues. She was forced to make the emergency landing on I-10 near Pensacola because of low oil pressure and a burning odor in the cockpit. Fortunately, she was able to land the aircraft safely without reaching an airport.
amharic: የ21 ዓመቷ የበረራ አስተማሪ በቴክኒክ ችግር ምክንያት ትንሿን አውሮፕላኗን በፍሎሪዳ ዋና መንገድ ላይ በሰላም አሳረፈች። በአውሮፕላኑ ውስጥ የዘይት ግፊት መቀነስ እና የማቃጠል ሽታ በመሰማቱ ወደ አየር ማረፊያ መድረስ ስላልቻለች በአስቸኳይ ሁኔታ I-10 በተባለው አውራ ጎዳና ላይ ለማረፍ ተገዳለች። እንደ እድል ሆኖ አውሮፕላኑን ምንም ጉዳት ሳይደርስበት በደህና ማሳረፍ ችላለች።
oromo: Leenjisaan balaliifii umrii waggaa 21 taate tokko, xiyyaarri ishee xiqqoon rakkoo teeknikaa mudate hordofee daandii guddaa Florida irratti nagaan lafa qubachiifte. Dhiibbaa zayitii hir'achuu fi urgaa gubataa xiyyaaricha keessatti waan itti dhaga'ameef, gara buufata xiyyaaraa geessuu waan dadhabdeef daandii I-10 irratti dirqamtee qubachiifte. Akkuma carraa ta'ee, xiyyaaricha miidhaa tokko malee nagaan lafa qubachiisuu dandeessiseetti.

title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro names Alfredo Gaspar as running mate
english: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro has selected Congressman Alfredo Gaspar as his vice-presidential running mate for the upcoming election against President Lula da Silva. Gaspar, a former public security official, is expected to help the campaign focus on sensitive topics like government pension scandals and public safety. This choice follows failed attempts by Bolsonaro to build broader political alliances or recruit a female candidate for the ticket.
amharic: የብራዚል ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ በፕሬዚዳንት ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ ላይ ለሚደረገው ምርጫ ምክትላቸው አድርገው ኮንግረስማን አልፍሬዶ ጋስፓርን መርጠዋል። የቀድሞ የፀጥታ ኃላፊ የሆኑት ጋስፓር፣ በጡረታ ፈንድ ቅሌት እና በሕዝብ ደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ በፕሬዚዳንቱ ላይ ተፅዕኖ ለመፍጠር እንደሚጠቀሙባቸው ይጠበቃል። ይህ ውሳኔ ቦልሶናሮ ሌሎች ሰፊ የፖለቲካ ጥምረት ለመፍጠር ያደረጉት ጥረት ካልተሳካ በኋላ የመጣ ነው።
oromo: Senatarichi biyya Braazil Flavio Bolsonaro, filannoo dhufu irratti pirezidantii Luula da Silvaa waliin dorgomuuf miseensa koongirasii Alfredo Gaaspaarii akka itti aanaa isaatti filataniiru. Gaaspaariin duraan ittigaafatamaa nageenyaa ta'anii kan hojjetan yoo ta'u, dhimmoota akka malaammaltuu sooramaa fi nageenya hawaasaa irratti mormitoota isaanii irratti fuulleffachuuf akka gargaaran eegama. Filannoon kun Bolsonaro mootummaa isaanii keessatti deggarsa bal'aa argachuuf yaalii godhan erga milkaa'uu dhabee booda kan murtaa'e dha.

title: Malaysia vows not to return Rohingya refugees to Myanmar if lives at risk
english: The Malaysian government has promised not to force 5,000 Rohingya refugees back to Myanmar if they face danger or persecution upon their return. While the Prime Minister previously proposed a repatriation plan, officials are now conducting a thorough review to ensure the safety of those involved. This decision follows significant pressure from human rights organizations and rising concerns over the safety of the Rohingya community in both Myanmar and Malaysia.
amharic: የማሌዥያ መንግስት ወደ ምያንማር የሚመለሱ 5,000 የሮሂንጋ ስደተኞች በዚያ የደህንነት ስጋት ወይም ስደት የሚገጥማቸው ከሆነ በግድ እንደማይመልሳቸው አስታውቋል። የሀገሪቱ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቀደም ሲል የመመለሻ እቅድ ማቅረባቸው ቢታወቅም፣ አሁን መንግስት የስደተኞቹን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ ዝርዝር ግምገማ እያደረገ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች ባቀረቡት ተቃውሞ እና በስደተኞች ደህንነት ላይ ባለው ስጋት ምክንያት ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Maaleeshiyaa baqattoota Roohingaa 5,000 ta'an yoo biyya isaaniitti deebi'an rakkoon ykn ari'atamni isaan mudatu ta'e dirqamaan gara Maaynaamarii akka hin deebisne waadaa galeera. Preezidaantiin biyyattii kanaan dura karoora deebisanii qubachiisuu qopheessanii kan turan ta'us, amma mootummaan nageenya baqattootaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoo cimaa gochaa jira. Murtoon kun kan dhufe mormii dhaabbilee mirga namoomaa fi yaaddoo nageenyaa baqattoota kanaa irratti ka'e hordofuudha.

title: Yemen foreign minsiter, UN envoy discuss Houthi attacks on Red Sea shipping
english: Yemeni foreign official Afrah Alzouba met with UN envoy Hans Grundberg to address the ongoing Houthi maritime attacks in the Red Sea. Alzouba condemned these actions as a threat to global trade and a catalyst for broader regional instability. In response, the UN envoy emphasized the urgent need to maintain peace and move forward with a political resolution to secure Yemen's future.
amharic: የየመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ተወካይ አፍራህ አልዙባ ከተባበሩት መንግስታት ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ሃንስ ግሩንድበርግ ጋር በቀይ ባህር ውስጥ እየተካሄደ ስላለው የሁቲዎች ጥቃት ተወያይተዋል። አልዙባ ጥቃቶቹ በአለም አቀፍ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ ስጋት መሆናቸውን እና ክልላዊ ግጭትን እንደሚያባብሱ ገልጸዋል። የዩኤን መልዕክተኛው በበኩላቸው የየመንን ሰላም እና መረጋጋት ለማምጣት የፖለቲካ ሂደቶችን ማጠናከር አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Hoggantuun ministeera dhimmi alaa Yaman Afraah Alzubaa ergaa dabarsaa gamtaa mootummootaa Hans Grundberg waliin ta'uun weerara gareen Huutii galaana diimaa keessatti gaggeessaa jiru irratti mari'ataniiru. Alzubaan weerarri kun daldala idil-addunyaa miidhuu fi naannichatti walitti bu'iinsa kan uumu ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ergaa dabarsichi gama isaaniin, nagaa fi tasgabbii Yaman mirkaneessuuf adeemsa siyaasaa irratti xiyyeeffachuun akka barbaachisu ibsaniiru.

title: From Michigan to Missouri: Democratic primaries deliver mixed bag on Israel and Gaza
english: Democratic primary elections held across five U.S. states have shown divided voter sentiment regarding the ongoing conflicts in Gaza and Iran. While progressive candidate Abdul El-Sayed secured a narrow victory in Michigan by campaigning against military aid to Israel, the party establishment saw success in Missouri as Wesley Bell defeated critic Cori Bush. These results highlight a significant internal debate within the Democratic Party over foreign policy and the best path forward for the upcoming general election.
amharic: በአምስት የአሜሪካ ግዛቶች የተካሄደው የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ምርጫ በጋዛ እና በኢራን እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት ዙሪያ የተከፋፈለ የምርጫ ውጤት አሳይቷል። አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በእስራኤል ላይ የሚደረግ ወታደራዊ ድጋፍን በመቃወም በምቺጋን ጠባብ ድል ሲቀዳጁ፣ በሌላ በኩል ደግሞ በምእራብ ሚዙሪ የፓርቲው ታዋቂ አባላት የጋዛን ጦርነት በመቃወም የሚታወቁትን ኮሪ ቡሽን በማሸነፍ የበላይነታቸውን አሳይተዋል። እነዚህ ውጤቶች በውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ ያለውን ከፍተኛ ልዩነት እና ክርክር ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Filannoon sadarkaa dursaa paartii Dimokiraatawaa kan states shan keessatti gaggeeffame, waraana Gazaafi Iraan ilaalchisee yaada uummataa kan gargar baase ta'eera. Abdul El-Sayed gargaarsa waraanaa Israa'el mormuudhaan Michigan keessatti yoo mo'atan, Missouri keessatti immoo namoonni dhaabbata paartichaa gargaaran, isaan waraana Gaza mormaa turan Cori Bush mo'achuun milkaa'aniiru. Bu'aaleen kun siyaasa alaa irratti miseensota paartii Dimokiraatawaa gidduutti garaagarummaan guddaan akka jiru agarsiisu.

title: After deadly Kyiv strike, Ukraine warns interceptor shortage is costing lives
english: A massive Russian aerial attack involving over 100 drones and two dozen missiles has killed at least 21 people in Ukraine. Ukrainian officials emphasized that they failed to intercept the ballistic missiles due to a critical shortage of defense supplies. This inability to stop incoming projectiles is increasingly leading to higher casualties and significant infrastructure damage across the country.
amharic: ሩሲያ ከ100 በላይ ድሮኖችን እና ሁለት ደርዘን ሚሳኤሎችን በመጠቀም በዩክሬን ባደረሰችው መጠነ ሰፊ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 21 ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። የዩክሬን ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት የአየር መከላከያ መሳሪያዎች እጥረት በመኖሩ ምክንያት ሚሳኤሎቹን መከላከል አልቻሉም። ይህ የመከላከያ አቅም መዳከም ለብዙ ሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋት እና ለከባድ የመሠረተ ልማት ውድመት ምክንያት እየሆነ ይገኛል።
oromo: Raashiyaan xiyyaroota rammachaa 100 ol fi misaa'eloota kudha lama fayyadamuun weerara gurguddaa Yukreen irratti gaggeessiteen namoonni 21 ol du'aniiru. Mootummaan Yukreen akka ibsetti, gargaarsa meeshaalee waraanaa fi ittisa qilleensa ishee irratti hanqina guddaan waan jiruuf misaa'eloota kana dhaabuu akka hin dandeenye beeksifteerti. Dandeettii ittisaa kana dhabuun namoota baay'ee lubbuu isaa kan galaafate fi miidhaa guddaa qabeenya irratti kan geessise dha.

title: US law enforcement reports deadly mass shooting in North Carolina
english: A deadly mass shooting occurred in Prospect Hill, North Carolina, leading to multiple fatalities and injuries. Law enforcement officials confirmed that one victim was taken to the hospital for treatment while authorities investigate the crime scene. Despite the tragedy, officials have stated that there is no ongoing danger to the local community.
amharic: በሰሜን ካሮላይና ፕሮስፔክት ሂል ከተማ በተፈጠረ አሰቃቂ የተኩስ አደጋ በርካታ ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። የህግ አስከባሪ አካላት ጉዳት የደረሰባቸውን ሰዎች ወደ ህክምና ተቋማት የወሰዱ ሲሆን፣ በአሁኑ ሰአት የወንጀል ምርመራ እየተካሄደ ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናቱ እንደገለጹት በአካባቢው ለህዝብ አሁን ላይ ምንም አይነት የደህንነት ስጋት የለም።
oromo: Magalaa Piroospekt Hiil kan naannoo Kaarolayinaa kaabaatti dhukaasa hamaa lubbuu galaafate mudatee jira. Abbootiin taayitaa nageenyaa namoota miidhaman gara hospitaalaatti erguun, ammas qorannoo dhimma kanaa irratti bobba'anii jiru. Haata'u malee, balaan kun to'annoo jala waan jiruuf, hawaasa naannichaa irratti balaan biraa akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Is the conflict between Russia and Ukraine deepening?
english: The conflict between Russia and Ukraine is intensifying as both nations ramp up drone and missile strikes, resulting in significant civilian casualties. Despite the escalation, there is currently no progress in diplomatic peace negotiations. Meanwhile, the international focus, particularly from the United States, has shifted toward tensions in other regions, leaving the future of this major conflict uncertain.
amharic: በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ሁለቱም ወገኖች ድሮን እና ሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን በማጠናከራቸው ምክንያት እየተባባሰ መጥቷል፣ ይህም ለበርካታ ንጹሃን ዜጎች ህይወት መጥፋት ምክንያት ሆኗል። ምንም እንኳን ግጭቱ እየተባባሰ ቢሄድም፣ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ የሰላም ንግግሮች ምንም አይነት መሻሻል አላሳዩም። በአሁኑ ወቅት የአለም አቀፍ ትኩረት በተለይም የአሜሪካ ትኩረት ወደ ሌሎች ቀጠናዎች በመዞሩ፣ የአውሮፓ ትልቁ ጦርነት የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Gogoggoggonni Ruusiyaa fi Yukreenii gidduu jiru erga labsamee asitti, lamaanuu haleellaa doonii fi misaa'elii gadi jabeessaa waan jiraniif lubbuun nagaa hedduu darbaa jira. Haala kanaan waraanni kun hammaatus, mariin nagaa fi dipiloomaasii homaatuu hin jijjiiramne. Yeroo ammaa kana xiyyeeffannoon addunyaa, keessattuu kan Ameerikaa, gara naannawota biroo waan lafaatiif, gara fuulduraa waraana kanaa irratti shakkiin guddaan jira.

title: Photos: Israeli forces raid occupied West Bank’s Qalandiya refugee camp
english: Israeli military forces conducted a raid on the Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank, resulting in the hospitalization of eight Palestinians and the arrest of at least 20 people. During the operation, soldiers occupied residential rooftops and issued threats to demolish local businesses. Residents expressed concern that these actions may be part of an effort to displace the local population to make room for planned illegal settlement expansion nearby.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በተያዘው ዌስት ባንክ በሚገኘው የቃላንዲያ የስደተኞች መጠለያ ካምፕ ላይ ወረራ አካሂደዋል። በዚህ ወረራ ቢያንስ 20 ሰዎች ሲታሰሩ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለው ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። ወታደሮቹ የአካባቢውን የንግድ ተቋማት እንደሚያፈርሱ ማስፈራሪያ የሰጡ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎች ይህ ድርጊት በአቅራቢያው ለሚገነባው ህገ-ወጥ ሰፈራ ቦታ ለመልቀቅ የታቀደ ስልት ነው ብለው በመስጋት ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el qubata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa kan Qarqara Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti argamu weeraruun namoota 20 ol ta'an hidhaniiru. Gocha kanaan namoonni 8 miidhamanii gara hospitaalaatti kan geeffaman yoo ta'u, waraanni sunis daldaltoota iddoo sanaa diiguun akka isaanis mana jireenyaa fi bakka hojii gadhiisan doorsiseera. Jiraattonni naannichaa akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun ijaarsa qubata seeraan alaa kan naannichaatti fuulleffatuuf lammiilee naannicha irraa ari'uuf kan karoorfame ta'uu mala jedhanii sodaatu.

title: El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary
english: Abdul El-Sayed has secured the Democratic nomination for the U.S. Senate in Michigan after a close race against Haley Stevens. Following his victory, El-Sayed emphasized the need for party cohesion to prepare for the upcoming general election. He is now set to compete against Republican candidate Mike Rogers in November.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሳየድ በሄይሊ ስቲቨንስ ላይ ባደረጉት ጠንካራ ፉክክር የሚቺጋን የዲሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የዩኤስ ሴኔት ዕጩ ሆነው ተመርጠዋል። ድሉን ተከትሎም በህዳር ወር ለሚካሄደው ዋና ምርጫ የፓርቲው አባላት በአንድነት እንዲቆሙ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ኤል-ሳየድ በምርጫው ከሪፐብሊካኑ ማይክ ሮጀርስ ጋር ይፎካከራሉ።
oromo: Abdul El-Sayed sagalee hedduu argachuun paartii Dimookraatawii bakka bu'ee filannoo seeneetii Miishiigan keessatti mo'ateera. Injifannoo isaa booda, El-Sayed filannoo Sadaasaa irratti injifachuuf miseensota paartichaa tokko ta'uun akka barbaachisu ibseera. Inni ammas filannoo guddicha irratti morkataa Ripabliikii kan ta'an Maayik Roojarsii waliin wal dorgomuuf qophaa'aa jira.

title: Puntland forces seize government-held camp in Somalia’s Galkayo
english: Military forces from the semi-autonomous Puntland region have taken control of a camp near Galkayo that was previously held by soldiers loyal to the Somali federal government. Puntland officials justified the attack by accusing the federal administration of building up military assets in the area to threaten regional stability. During the operation, security forces arrested over 100 individuals and confiscated various weapons and supplies following an hour of intense fighting.
amharic: የፑንትላንድ የጸጥታ ኃይሎች በጋልካዮ ከተማ የፌዴራል መንግሥት ቁጥጥር ሥር የነበረውን ወታደራዊ ካምፕ መቆጣጠራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የፑንትላንድ አመራሮች ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የፌዴራል መንግሥት ክልሉን ለማተራመስ የሚያደርገውን እንቅስቃሴ ለመከላከል መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በግጭቱ ወቅት ከአንድ ሰዓት በላይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ የተካሄደ ሲሆን፣ የፑንትላንድ ኃይሎች ከ100 በላይ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ሥር በማዋል የተለያዩ የጦር መሳሪያዎችን መማረካቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humnootni nageenyaa naannoo Puntlaand, magaalaa Gaalkacyo keessatti buufata waraanaa mootummaa federaalaa harka ture to'annoo isaanii jala oolchaniiru. Hooggantootni Puntlaand akka jedhanitti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame mootummaan federaalaa naannichatti hidhannoofi humna waraanaa walitti qabuun nageenya naannichaa booressuuf yaalii waan godheefidha. Sa'aatii tokkoo ol walitti bu'iinsa cimaa booda, humnootni Puntlaand namoota 100 ol hidhuu fi meeshaalee waraanaa hedduu booji'uu isaanii beekameera.

title: Yemen's Houthis say they targeted Saudi oil vessel in Gulf of Aden
english: Houthi forces in Yemen have claimed responsibility for an attack on a Saudi oil tanker located in the Gulf of Aden. While Saudi authorities have yet to verify the incident, maritime reports confirmed a loud blast occurred near a ship in that vicinity. This development highlights ongoing tensions involving commercial shipping routes in the region.
amharic: የየመኑ ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በአደን ባህረ ሰላጤ ውስጥ በሚገኝ የሳውዲ አረቢያ ነዳጅ ጫኝ መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሳውዲ መንግስት እስካሁን ጥቃቱን ያረጋገጠ ነገር ባይኖርም፣ በአካባቢው የነበሩ መርከበኞች የፍንዳታ ድምፅ መሰማቱን ዘግበዋል። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ የንግድ መርከቦች ላይ እየተፈጠረ ያለውን የጸጥታ ስጋት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Humni Hootii kan Yaman, doonii boba'aa kan Sa'udii Arabaa kan Galaana Eeden keessa ture irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaa beeksise. Mootummaan Sa'udii ammaaf waa'ee haleellaa kanaa kan mirkaneesse hin jiru, ta'us gabaasni qarqara galaanarraa akka ibsutti, doonii naannicha keessa ture tokko biratti sagaleen dhukaatii guddaan dhaga'ameera. Kunis nageenya dooniiwwan daldalaa kan naannichaa irratti yaaddoo uumeera.

title: Far-right Israeli settlers illegally enter Lebanon, most escorted back
english: A group of far-right Israeli women linked to a movement advocating for settlements in Lebanon illegally crossed the border into southern Lebanese territory on Wednesday. The Israeli military confirmed that most individuals were found and returned home, while a search continues for those still missing. This incident follows recent public support from senior Israeli government officials for the idea of establishing settlements in that region.
amharic: በሊባኖስ ውስጥ ሰፈራ እንዲኖር የሚደግፉ አንዳንድ የቀኝ ዘመም እስራኤላውያን ቡድን አባላት ረቡዕ ዕለት በሕገ-ወጥ መንገድ የሊባኖስን ድንበር ጥሰው ገብተዋል። እስራኤል አብዛኞቹን አባላት አግኝታ ወደ አገራቸው መመለሷን የገለጸች ሲሆን፣ የተወሰኑትን የመፈለግ ሥራ አሁንም እየተከናወነ ይገኛል። ይህ ድርጊት የተፈጸመው አንዳንድ ከፍተኛ የእስራኤል ባለሥልጣናት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ሰፈራ መመሥረትን በመደገፍ መግለጫ ከሰጡ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Hiriirtota Israa'el kan ta'an gareen dubartoota muraasa tokko, biyyattiin kibba Liibaanoos keessatti qubsuma akka ijaartu kan barbaadan, guyyaa Roobii darbe seeraan ala daangaa ce'anii gara Liibaanoos seenaniiru. Raayyaan ittisa Israa'el akka ibsetti, hedduun isaanii argamanii gara Israa'el deebi'aniiru, garuu warra hafan barbaaduun ammas itti fufee jira. Gochi kun kan raawwatame hoogganoonni mootummaa Israa'el tokko tokko kibba Liibaanoos keessatti qubsuma ijaaruuf deeggarsa kennuu isaanii erga ibsanii booda.

title: US Centcom says it redirected three more commercial vessels
english: The U.S. Central Command recently diverted three additional commercial ships as part of its ongoing blockade strategy against Iran. Since the enforcement began in early August, the military has intercepted 48 vessels in total. These operations also included disabling two ships and boarding another two to maintain control in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም ኢራን ላይ በጣለው ማዕቀብ መሰረት ተጨማሪ ሶስት የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ አስቀይሯል። ከነሐሴ ወር መጀመሪያ ጀምሮ በተጀመረው በዚህ የክትትል ስራ እስካሁን 48 መርከቦች የተጠለፉ ሲሆን፣ ሁለት መርከቦች አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ ተደርገዋል እንዲሁም በሁለት ሌሎች መርከቦች ላይም ወታደራዊ ፍተሻ ተካሂዷል።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) tarkaanfii Iranirratti fudhachaa jiruun walqabatee, markaboota daldalaa dabalataa sadii gara biraatti akka geeddaran taasiseera. Sadaasa darbe irraa kaasee hojiin to'annoo kun erga eegalee, markaboonni 48 ta'an kan redirection godhaman yoo ta'u, markaboonni lama hojiin ala ta'anii, akkasumas markaboonni lama ammoo qorannoon irratti geggeeffameera.

title: Arab Ministerial Committee discusses occupied East Jerusalem in meeting
english: Foreign ministers from several Arab nations and Pakistan met with Jordan’s King Abdullah II in Amman to address the rising tensions in occupied East Jerusalem. The committee discussed coordinated international strategies to challenge Israeli policies in the region. This high-level gathering focused on responding to recent developments and protecting Palestinian interests in the city.
amharic: የተለያዩ የአረብ ሀገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮችና ፓኪስታን በአማን ተገናኝተው በተያዘው ምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም እየተባባሰ ስላለው ሁኔታ ከዮርዳኖሱ ንጉስ አብዱላህ ዳግማዊ ጋር ተወያይተዋል። የኮሚቴው አባላት በእየሩሳሌም እየተወሰዱ ያሉትን የእስራኤል እርምጃዎች ለመጋፈጥ ዓለም አቀፍ የጋራ አቋም ለመውሰድ መክረዋል። ስብሰባው በአካባቢው እየተከሰቱ ያሉ ለውጦችን ለመቋቋም እና የፍልስጤማውያንን መብት ለማስከበር ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimmi alaa biyyoota Arabaa fi Paakistaan magaalattii Amman keessatti mootii Yordaanos Abdullah lammaffaa waliin walgahii taasisaniiru. Walgahiin kun kan xiyyeeffate haala yeroodhaa gara yerootti hammaataa jiru fi dhiibbaa Israa'el magaalaa Yerusaalem keessatti gaggeessaa jirtu irratti dha. Ministiroonni kunneen tarkaanfii Israa'el fudhattu akkamitti akka dhaabuu danda'an irratti mari'achuun, haala jiru ilaalchisee tarkaanfii idil-addunyaa waloo fudhachuuf waliigalan.

title: Iran’s deputy foreign minister says no talks with the US held in recent days, Oman route almost finalised
english: Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi stated that there have been no recent negotiations with the United States. He emphasized that while the U.S. fulfilling its previous commitments is important, it is not enough to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, officials are close to finalizing an agreement with Oman to establish a temporary shipping route in the area for the coming months.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ካዜም ጋሪባባዲ ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ጋር በቅርብ ቀናት ውስጥ ምንም አይነት ንግግሮች እንዳልተደረጉ አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ ቀደም ሲል የገባችውን ቃል ብትፈጽም እንኳን፣ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤን ለመክፈት ብቻውን በቂ እንዳልሆነ ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ በኩል ለሚቀጥሉት ጥቂት ወራት የሚቆይ ጊዜያዊ የመተላለፊያ መንገድ ለመፍጠር ከኦማን ጋር ያደረገችው ስምምነት መጠናቀቂያ ላይ ደርሷል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Itti-aanaan Iran Kaazem Gaaribaabaadii guyyoota darban keessa Ameerikaa waliin mariin tokko illee hin taasifamne jedhan. Ameerikaan waadaa ishee durii kabajuun barbaachisaa ta’us, daandiin galaana Hormuz akka banamuuf qofti ga’aa akka hin taane ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Iran bakka sanatti ji’oota dhufan keessa daandii markaabaa yeroo gabaabaa fayyadamuuf mootummaa Omaan waliin walii galtee irra ga’uuf qophiirra jirti.

title: Russia kills 17 in ballistic missile attacks around Kyiv
english: A recent overnight assault by Russia involving ballistic missiles and drones has resulted in at least 17 deaths in and around the Ukrainian capital of Kyiv. While Ukrainian officials report that the strikes caused significant damage to civilian facilities, Moscow claims their military actions were directed specifically at defense targets. This deadly attack marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict between the two nations.
amharic: ሩሲያ በኪየቭ እና በአካባቢዋ ባደረሰችው የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል እና የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተዘግቧል። የዩክሬን ባለሥልጣናት ጥቃቱ የሲቪል መሰረተ ልማቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገ መሆኑን ሲገልጹ፣ ሞስኮ በበኩሏ ወታደራዊ ቦታዎችን ማጥቃቷን ትናገራለች። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለው ጦርነት ከፍተኛ መባባሱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Rusiyan magaalaa Kiyivii fi naannawa ishee irratti haleellaa kombii fi miisayilii baaliistikii taasisteen namoonni 17 ol ajjeefamaniiru. Mootummaan Yukreen haleellaan kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa sivilii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ta'uu ibsuun, gama biraatiin immoo Moskon haleellaa kana bakkeewwan waraanaa irratti qofa gaggeessine jechuun falmati. Haleellaan kun waldhabiinsa biyyoota lamaanii gidduutti jiru gara sadarkaa hamaatti dabarsuun isaa ibsameera.

title: Pope Leo XIV to visit Peru, Argentina and Uruguay in November
english: Pope Leo XIV is scheduled to visit Uruguay, Argentina, and Peru this November, marking his first papal trip to Latin America. This visit is highly significant as it includes a return to Peru, where the Pope previously served as a missionary and bishop for many years. Additionally, the trip will be the first papal visit to Argentina and Uruguay in nearly four decades.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ በህዳር ወር ኡራጓይ፣ አርጀንቲና እና ፔሩን ይጎበኛሉ። ይህ ጉብኝት እንደ ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ወደ ላቲን አሜሪካ የሚያደርጉት የመጀመሪያው ጉዞ ሲሆን፣ በተለይም ለብዙ ዓመታት ሚስዮናዊ እና ጳጳስ ሆነው ያገለገሉበት ፔሩ መመለሳቸው ትልቅ ትርጉም አለው። በተጨማሪም፣ ይህ ጉብኝት ከ40 ዓመታት በኋላ ወደ አርጀንቲና እና ኡራጓይ የሚደረግ የመጀመሪያው የጳጳሳት ጉብኝት ይሆናል።
oromo: Paappaan Leo 14ffaan ji'a Sadaasaa keessa biyyoota Urugway, Arjantiinaa fi Peeruu daawwachuuf karoorfateera. Daawwachi kun taayitaa paappaummaa erga fudhatanii booda gara Laatin Ameerikaatti kan godhan imala jalqabaati. Keessattuu, waggoota dheeraaf misiyoonaarii fi phaaphaasii ta'anii tajaajilaa turan biyya Peeruu deebi'anii daawwachuun isaanii addatti kan barbaachisuudha; akkasumas kun waggoota 40 keessatti biyyoota Arjantiinaa fi Urugwayitti imala paappaasii jalqabaa ta'a.

title: Puerto Rican cities hit with water rationing measures during record drought
english: Puerto Rico has initiated rotating water rationing for over 180,000 residents in San Juan and surrounding areas due to a record-breaking, severe drought. Governor Jenniffer Gonzalez noted that the measures are necessary as extreme dry weather and heat are expected to continue through September. Many citizens are struggling with these new restrictions, noting that their communities have already faced inconsistent water supplies for months.
amharic: በፖርቶ ሪኮ እየተከሰተ ባለው ከባድ ድርቅ ምክንያት በሳን ሁዋን እና በአካባቢው በሚገኙ ዋና ዋና ከተሞች የሚኖሩ ከ180,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች የውሃ አጠቃቀም ተገደበ። የክልሉ አስተዳደር እንዳስታወቀው፣ እጅግ በጣም ሞቃታማ እና ደረቅ የአየር ሁኔታ እስከ መስከረም ወር ድረስ ሊቀጥል ስለሚችል ይህ የውሃ ክፍፍል ሥርዓት አስፈላጊ ሆኗል። በርካታ ነዋሪዎች ቀድሞውንም በውሃ እጥረት እየተቸገሩ መሆኑን በመጥቀስ፣ አዲሱ ገደብ የኑሮ ጫናቸውን እንዳባባሰው ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Puerto Rico keessatti gogiinsi cimaan uumamee waan jiruuf, magaalaa San Juan fi naannoowwan ishee keessatti jiraattonni 180,000 ol ta'an bishaan hiruun itti fayyadamuuf dirqamaniiru. Mootummaan akka ibsetetti, roobni dhabamuu fi ho’i cimaan hanga baatii Fulbaanaatti itti fufu waan maluuf, murteen kun fudhatameera. Jiraattonni hedduun haala kanaan dura bishaan dhabuun isaan mudachaa ture yaadachaa, murteen kun jireenya isaanii irratti rakkoo dabalataa uumuu isaa ibsachaa jiru.

title: Arab officials call for action over Jerusalem tensions
english: Foreign ministers from various Arab and Muslim-majority nations recently convened in Amman to discuss rising instability in Jerusalem and the occupied Palestinian territories. The participating officials urged the global community to take urgent steps to stop Israeli actions in the region. They also emphasized the necessity of ensuring the safety and protection of sacred religious sites.
amharic: የተለያዩ የአረብ እና ሙስሊም አገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በኢየሩሳሌም እና በተያዙት የፍልስጤም ግዛቶች እየተባባሰ የመጣውን አለመረጋጋት ለመወያየት በአማን ተሰብስበዋል። የተሳታፊዎቹ ሀገራት ዲፕሎማቶች ዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ በእስራኤል በኩል የሚፈጸሙ ጥሰቶችን ለማስቆም አስቸኳይ እርምጃ እንዲወስድ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። በተጨማሪም፣ ቅዱስ የሃይማኖት ስፍራዎችን የመጠበቅ እና የደህንነታቸውን የማረጋገጥ አስፈላጊነት ላይ አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Arabaa fi biyyoota muslima hedduu ta'an irraa walitti dhufan, rakkoo Yerusaalemii fi naannawaa Palasxinaa keessatti uumame irratti mari'achuuf magaalaa Ammanitti walga'ii gaggeessaniiru. Qondaalonni kunneen gochoota Israa'el naannichatti raawwattu dhaabsisuuf hawaasni addunyaa tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa akka fudhatu gaafataniiru. Akkasumas, bakkeewwan amantii qulqulluu ta'an eeggumsa argachuu akka qaban hubachiisaniiru.

title: Top Arab, Muslim diplomats launch plan to protect Jerusalem religious sites
english: Foreign ministers from various Arab and Muslim nations have formed a new collaborative committee to monitor and publicize Israeli actions affecting religious sites in East Jerusalem. They aim to use a dedicated media platform to highlight concerns about the status of holy places, such as the Al-Aqsa Mosque, to the international community. The group warns that these ongoing policies threaten regional stability and violate the historical identity of the city.
amharic: የተለያዩ የአረብ እና የእስልምና ሀገራት የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትሮች በምስራቅ እየሩሳሌም በሚገኙ ሃይማኖታዊ ስፍራዎች ላይ እስራኤል የምትወስዳቸውን እርምጃዎች ለመከታተልና ለዓለም ለማጋለጥ የሚያስችል የጋራ ኮሚቴ አቋቁመዋል። ቡድኑ የአል-አቅሳ መስጊድን ጨምሮ የቅዱስ ስፍራዎችን ሁኔታ ለዓለም አቀፉ ማህበረሰብ ለማሳወቅ ልዩ የሚዲያ መድረክ እንደሚጠቀም አስታውቋል። እነዚህ እየተካሄዱ ያሉ ድርጊቶች የክልሉን ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥሉና የከተማዋን ታሪካዊ ማንነት እንደሚሸረሽሩም አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Ministiroonni dhimma alaa biyyoota Arabaa fi Muslimaa garaa garaa, tarkaanfii Israa'el iddoowwan amantii magaalaa Yerusaalem keessatti fudhattu hordofuu fi addunyaatti ibsuuf garee waliinii tokko hundeessaniiru. Gareen kun, masjiida Al-Aqsaa dabalatee iddoowwan qulqulluu irratti miidhaa gahaa jiru hunda miidiyaalee addunyaatti beeksisuuf karoorfateera. Tarkaanfiin Israa'el kun nagaa naannichaa kan booressuu fi eenyummaa seenaa magaalaashee kan jijjiiru ta'uu isaatiin hubachiisaniiru.

title: Rubio, Miliband discuss Europe taking greater role in its own security
english: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio met with UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband in Washington to discuss the need for European nations to increase their responsibility for regional security. This meeting follows Miliband's recent appointment by Prime Minister Andy Burnham. Despite the focus on security cooperation, the White House has expressed apprehension regarding Miliband's previous environmental policy decisions.
amharic: የአሜሪካው የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ማርኮ ሩቢዮ ከእንግሊዝ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ኤድ ሚሊባንድ ጋር በዋሽንግተን ተገናኝተው በአውሮፓ የደህንነት ጉዳዮች ላይ ተወያይተዋል። ውይይቱ በአውሮፓ አገራት የራሳቸውን ደህንነት የመጠበቅ ኃላፊነት እንዲጨምሩ የሚያሳስብ ነው። ሆኖም፣ የዋይት ሃውስ በኤድ ሚሊባንድ የቀድሞ የአየር ንብረት ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ያለውን ስጋት ገልጿል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Amerikaa Maarkoo Ruubiyoo fi Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa UK Eed Miilibaandi Waashingitanitti wal arguun, biyyoonni Awurooppaa nageenya naannawa isaanii eeggachuu irratti qooda guddaa akka qabaatan mari'ataniiru. Mariin kun muudama Miilibaandi kan haaraa booda kan ta'e yoo ta'u, gama biraatiin garuu, Waayit Haawusiin siyaasa inni kanaan dura dhimma naannoo irratti hordofaa ture ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabaachuu isaa ibseera.

title: Eight Palestinians injured in large-scale Israeli raid of Jerusalem refugee camp
english: Israeli forces conducted a major military operation in the Qalandiya refugee camp and Kafr Aqab, resulting in eight injuries among Palestinians. During the raid, the military imposed strict movement restrictions, detained several individuals, and targeted journalists reporting on the event. The operation also involved placing snipers in residential areas and disrupting local religious services.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በቃላንድያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ እና በካፍር አቃብ ከተማ ባደረገው ሰፊ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። በዘመቻው ወቅት ጦሩ ጥብቅ የሰዓታት እላፊ በመጣል፣ በርካታ ሰዎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሎ፣ እንዲሁም ክንውኑን በመዘገብ ላይ የነበሩ ጋዜጠኞችን አሳድዷል። በተጨማሪም ወታደሮቹ በየቤቱ ጣሪያ ላይ ተኳሾችን በማስቀመጥ እና የሃይማኖታዊ ስነ-ስርዓቶችን በማስተጓጎል አካባቢውን ሙሉ በሙሉ ተቆጣጥረውት ነበር።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el buufata baqattootaa Qalandiyaa fi magaalaa Kafr Aqaab keessatti duula waraanaa bal'aa gaggeessaniin Palastinaa saddeet irra miidhaan ga'eera. Duula kanaan, waraanni ajaja mana keessatti qabamuu labsuun namoota hedduu hidheera, akkasumas gabaastota ta'ichi gabaasaa turan irratti tarkaanfiin fudhatameera. Duulichi halkan keessa warreen rasaasaa dhukaasan gamoo irratti ramaduu fi sagantaalee amantii gufachiisuu dabalata.

title: Netanyahu says Trump is a ‘great friend’ but Israel will do ‘whatever it takes’ for security
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu stated that his country will prioritize its national security above all else, regardless of any international agreements. While acknowledging Donald Trump as a strong ally, he emphasized that Israel’s survival is non-negotiable. This declaration follows Israel's ongoing military actions in southern Lebanon despite efforts by the U.S. to broker a withdrawal deal.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሀገራቸው ደህንነት ከማንኛውም ዓለም አቀፍ ስምምነት በላይ ቅድሚያ እንደሚሰጠው አስታውቀዋል። ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ለእስራኤል ትልቅ ወዳጅ መሆናቸውን የገለጹት ኔታንያሁ፣ የእስራኤል ህልውና ድርድር የማይደረግበት ጉዳይ መሆኑን አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል። ይህ መግለጫ የወጣው አሜሪካ በሊባኖስ በኩል የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለማድረግ እየሞከረች ባለችበት ወቅት፣ እስራኤል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃቷን የቀጠለችበት ጊዜ ላይ ነው።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Israa'el Benyaamiin Neetaanyaahuu, mootummaan isaa nageenya biyyasaatiif jecha, walii galtee idil-addunyaa kamiyyuu osoo hin eegatin tarkaanfii barbaachisu fudhachuu akka itti fufu ibsaniiru. Donald Tiraamp hiriyyaa cimaa ta'uu isaanii kan dubbatan ta'us, jiraachuu fi nageenyi Israa'el dhimma marii irra hin oollee dha jedhaniiru. Ibsi kun kan ba'e, yeroo Ameerikaan walii galtee nagaa Libaanoos keessatti uumuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtutti, Israa'el kibba Libaanoos keessatti haleellaa waraanaa itti fuftee jirtutti.

title: UK maritime authority reports ‘loud explosion’ near ship southeast of Yemeni coast
english: British maritime officials have reported a powerful blast occurring near a ship located southeast of the Yemeni port of Aden. Despite the incident, authorities confirmed that the crew members are unharmed and the vessel has sustained no environmental damage. An official investigation and warning have been issued regarding the safety of the area.
amharic: የብሪታንያ የባህር ላይ ንግድ ኦፕሬሽን ባለስልጣናት ከየመን አደን ወደብ በስተደቡብ ምስራቅ በኩል በአንድ መርከብ አቅራቢያ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ እንደተከሰተ አስታውቀዋል። በዚህ አደጋ የመርከቧ ሰራተኞች ምንም ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰባቸውና በአካባቢውም የአካባቢ ብክለት አለመፈጠሩን አረጋግጠዋል። ስለ ሁኔታው አስፈላጊው ማስጠንቀቂያ የተላለፈ ሲሆን ተጨማሪ ክትትል እየተደረገ ነው።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa daldala galaanaa biyya Ingiliz, markabii gara kibba-baha buufata markabaa Aden kan Yemenitti dhihoo jirtu biratti dhuka'iinsa guddaan tokko akka mudate gabaasaniiru. Balaa kanaan, hojjettoonni markabittii hundi miidhaa tokko malee nagaan akka jiranifi naannichattis balaan naannoo irra gahe akka hin jirre ibsameera. Taateen kun hordofamaa jiraachuun beekameera.

title: Exclusive: Cambridge University backtracks on divesting from arms companies
english: The University of Cambridge has reversed its decision to completely divest from companies involved in arms manufacturing. Instead, the institution will now implement a monitoring system to track and limit its financial exposure to conventional weapons producers. This policy shift follows recent pressure and protests from students advocating for the university to cut ties with the defense industry.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ከጦር መሳሪያ አምራች ኩባንያዎች ጋር ያለውን የገንዘብ ግንኙነት ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማቋረጥ የነበረውን ውሳኔ ቀይሯል። በምትኩ፣ ተቋሙ በጦር መሳሪያ አምራቾች ላይ ያለውን የኢንቨስትመንት ድርሻ የሚከታተል እና የሚገድብ አዲስ ሥርዓት ዘርግቷል። ይህ ውሳኔ የተወሰነው ዩኒቨርሲቲው ከጦር መሳሪያ ኢንዱስትሪዎች ጋር ያለውን ግንኙነት እንዲያቋርጥ በተማሪዎች ከቀረበው ተደጋጋሚ ተጽዕኖ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Yuunivarsiitiin Kaambirij warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa oomishan irraa qabeenya isaa guututti baasuuf murteeffatee ture akka waaqatti deebisee jira. Kanaa mannaa, dhaabbatichi amma qabeenya isaa warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa irratti bobbaase to'achuufi daangessuuf sirna haaraa diriirse jira. Murteen kun kan dhufeyis barattoonni dhaabbatichi warshaalee meeshaa waraanaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya akka qabaatu hin barbaanne jechuun dhiibbaa taasisaa turan booda dha.

title: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan
english: Abdul El-Sayed, a progressive newcomer and former public health official, has secured the Democratic nomination for the US Senate in Michigan by defeating moderate incumbent Haley Stevens. His platform focuses on universal healthcare and major changes to immigration and foreign policy. El-Sayed will now compete against Republican Mike Rogers in the upcoming November midterm elections.
amharic: አብዱል ኤል-ሰይድ የተባሉ የግራ ዘመም ፖለቲካዊ አመለካከት ያላቸው አዲስ ሰው፣ በሚቺጋን ግዛት በተካሄደው የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ የምርጫ ውድድር አሸንፈዋል። የቀድሞው የህዝብ ጤና ባለስልጣን የሆኑት ኤል-ሰይድ፣ በመካከለኛ አቋም የሚታወቁትን ሄሊ ስቲቨንስን በመርታት ለእጩነት በቅተዋል። አሸናፊው እጩ በሚቀጥለው ህዳር በሚካሄደው የሀገር አቀፍ ምርጫ ከሪፐብሊካኑ ማይክ ሮጀርስ ጋር ይፎካከራሉ።
oromo: Abduul El-Sayed kan jedhaman fi siyaasa gara bitaa kan deggeran namni haaraan kun, filannoo duraa kan paartii Dimookiraatawaa kan miichiigan keessatti gaggeeffame injifataniiru. Ogeessi fayyaa hawaasaa duraanii kun, namoota giddu-galeessa ta'an kan Haley Stevens jedhaman mo'achuun muudama paartichaa argataniiru. Injifataan kunis filannoo biyyoolessa kan ji'a Sadaasaa dhufu keessa namicha Paartii Ripaabilikaanii kan ta'an Mike Rogers wajjin kan dorgoman ta'a.

title: What can scientists learn from a stray SpaceX rocket hitting the Moon?
english: A discarded SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket stage recently crashed into the Moon near the Einstein crater at high speed. While the impact was difficult to observe due to lighting conditions, scientists view this accidental collision as a valuable research opportunity. By studying the resulting crater, planetary geologists hope to gain new insights that will benefit future space missions.
amharic: የስፔስ ኤክስ (SpaceX) ፋልኮን 9 ሮኬት ክፍል በቅርቡ በጨረቃ ላይ በሚገኘው የአይንስታይን ጉድጓድ አቅራቢያ በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት ተጋጭቷል። ይህ አደጋ በጨረቃ ገጽ ላይ የፈጠረውን ጉድጓድ ማጥናት ለሳይንቲስቶች አዲስ እና ጠቃሚ መረጃዎችን ለማግኘት ዕድል ሰጥቷቸዋል። ተመራማሪዎች ከዚህ ግጭት የሚገኘውን መረጃ ለወደፊት የጠፈር ጉዞዎች ስኬት እንደሚጠቀሙበት ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Kutaan rokkeetii SpaceX Falcon 9 ta'e tokko dhiheenya kana saffisa olaanaadhaan gara ji'aatti bu'ee 'Einstein crater' jedhamu biratti qaxxaamura uumera. Taphni kun erga uumamee booda, saayintistoonni iddoo sanatti uumamee qorachuun odeeffannoo gara fuulduraatti ergawwan hawaa fayyadan argachuuf carraa guddaa akka ta'e ibsaniiru. Qorattoonni rokkeetiin sun ji'a irratti midhaa geessise irraa hubannoo haaraa akka argatan abdachiisaniiru.
